_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Queen's Recruit#001.src: Tasim is looking to catch up in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Queen's Recruit#001.dst: Tasim が {p} の [{~}, {~}, -{~}] で話したがっている。

Queen's Recruit#002.src: {u}! Hey! It's lucky I managed to catch you here.
Queen's Recruit#002.dst: {u}！やあ！ここで会えるなんてついてるな。
Queen's Recruit#002.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#003.src: It's been a while, hasn't it? We should catch up! You've probably had lots of adventures, right?
Queen's Recruit#003.dst: 久しぶりだね？積もる話もあるし！君もたくさん冒険してきたんだろう？
Queen's Recruit#003.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#004.src: But before that... I've just got to find...
Queen's Recruit#004.dst: でもその前に… 探さないと…
Queen's Recruit#004.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#005.src: Huh? What am I oh, yeah. I'm trying to find Aledar.
Queen's Recruit#005.dst: え？何を… ああそうだ。Aledar を探してるんだ。
Queen's Recruit#005.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#006.src: He sent me a letter asking me to join him on some... scouting mission. But I haven't been able to find him.
Queen's Recruit#006.dst: 偵察任務に… 一緒に来てくれって手紙をくれたんだ。でも見つからなくて。
Queen's Recruit#006.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#007.src: It did take me a while to get here... so maybe he's gone somewhere else by now. Aegis did tell me the mission ended up being called off, so...
Queen's Recruit#007.dst: ここに来るまで時間がかかったから… もう別の場所に行ったのかも。Aegis 提督も任務は中止になったって言ってたし…
Queen's Recruit#007.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#008.src: But if he's not here, then I should probably stop trying to catch him on the streets, huh? I'll just leave a message for him at the barracks.
Queen's Recruit#008.dst: でもここにいないなら、街中を探し回るのはやめたほうがいいか。兵舎に伝言を残しておくよ。
Queen's Recruit#008.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#009.src: We can head to the tavern and catch up! Gods, I've missed the Rusty Recruit's drinks... that barkeeper, he says it's the same as anywhere else, but it really isn't! Nowhere else pours it like he does.
Queen's Recruit#009.dst: 酒場で話そう！ああ、Rusty Recruit の酒が恋しかった… あのバーテンはどこも同じだって言うけど、全然違うんだ！あんな風に注げる人は他にいない。
Queen's Recruit#009.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#010.src: Pardon me, excuse me coming through! Coming through! Ah, you two! Just the folks I was looking for.
Queen's Recruit#010.dst: 失礼、ちょっと通して！通りますよ！ああ、お二人さん！ちょうど探してたんです。
Queen's Recruit#010.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#012.src: Well, perhaps not specifically. I've got a list of folks to try and track down, and the two of you are on it! Tasim and {u}, right?
Queen's Recruit#012.dst: いや、名指しってほどでも。探す人のリストがあって、お二人も載ってるんです！Tasim さんと {u} さんですよね？
Queen's Recruit#012.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#013.src: I've got an important missive from {p}. Direct from the King himself, yep yep!
Queen's Recruit#013.dst: {p} から大事な書状です。王様直々ですよ、ええ！
Queen's Recruit#013.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#014.src: Really? I don't think I've even seen him since... what could he possibly want us for?
Queen's Recruit#014.dst: 本当に？あれ以来会ってもいないのに… 僕たちに何の用だろう？
Queen's Recruit#014.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#015.src: I'm not privy to the details I'm afraid! He's summoning a number of you seasoned visitors to the castle, for some sort of meeting.
Queen's Recruit#015.dst: 詳しいことは存じません！ベテランの皆さんを何人も城に呼んで、何かの会議をなさるそうです。
Queen's Recruit#015.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#016.src: Anyway, I've got more to try and track down, so I'll give you the written letters and be on my way! Best of luck with whatever it is!
Queen's Recruit#016.dst: とにかく、まだ探す人がいるので、手紙を渡して失礼しますね！何の件にせよ、ご健闘を！
Queen's Recruit#016.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#018.src: Hm. That is strange, isn't it? I guess we'll have to call off drinks for later... probably for the best. Maybe I'll be able to catch him before...
Queen's Recruit#018.dst: うーん。妙だよね？飲みに行くのはお預けか… そのほうがいいかも。その前に彼をつかまえられるかな…
Queen's Recruit#018.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#019.src: Oh, uh- you go on ahead. I have to stop by the barracks first. I'll meet you in {p}, then?
Queen's Recruit#019.dst: あ、えっと… 先に行ってて。僕は兵舎に寄らないと。{p} で合流しよう？
Queen's Recruit#019.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#020.src: I'll meet you in {p}. I have to deal with some things at the barracks first.
Queen's Recruit#020.dst: {p} で合流しよう。先に兵舎で片付けることがあるんだ。
Queen's Recruit#020.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#021.src: Attend the meeting with the King in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Queen's Recruit#021.dst: {p} の [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で王との会議に出席する。

Queen's Recruit#022.src: ...oh, there you are. Didn't you head out before me?
Queen's Recruit#022.dst: …あ、いた。僕より先に出たんじゃなかった？
Queen's Recruit#022.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#023.src: I don't know most of the people here, so I'll stick with you for now.
Queen's Recruit#023.dst: ここの人はほとんど知らないから、しばらく君と一緒にいるよ。
Queen's Recruit#023.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#024.src: ...and it's all crashing down, right? So I knock the zombie back, grab the kid, and jump for
Queen's Recruit#024.dst: …で、全部崩れてくるだろ？だからゾンビを押し返して、子供をつかんで跳んで
Queen's Recruit#024.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#025.src: Wait, wait wait wait you're tellin' me there was a kid involved? And you still set off the bombs?!
Queen's Recruit#025.dst: 待った待った待った、子供がいたってのかい？それでも爆弾を起動したって？！
Queen's Recruit#025.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#026.src: Yeah! I said that already, right? That was the whole reason I
Queen's Recruit#026.dst: そうだよ！もう言ったよな？それこそが俺が
Queen's Recruit#026.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#027.src: Ahem. Pause the story for a bit, Linton. We have company.
Queen's Recruit#027.dst: こほん。話は一旦止めて、Linton。お客さんよ。
Queen's Recruit#027.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#028.src: Well if it ain't {u}! It's good to see someone else familiar 'round here.
Queen's Recruit#028.dst: おや、{u} じゃないか！ここで顔なじみに会えて嬉しいよ。
Queen's Recruit#028.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#029.dst: 何だよ、俺は顔なじみじゃないのか？
Queen's Recruit#029.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#030.src: I do try to keep my distance.
Queen's Recruit#030.dst: あんたとは距離を置いてるからね。
Queen's Recruit#030.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#031.src: So, you received the summons too? The King has a lot of people here. It's interesting.
Queen's Recruit#031.dst: あなたたちも召集を受けたの？王はずいぶん人を集めたみたい。興味深いわ。
Queen's Recruit#031.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#032.src: We did, yes. And it sounded like they had even more people on that list that they were searching for.
Queen's Recruit#032.dst: うん、受けたよ。それに、名簿にはまだ探してる人がたくさんいるみたいだった。
Queen's Recruit#032.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#033.src: Oh, apologies, I hadn't noticed you there. You're a friend of {u}'s, I take it?
Queen's Recruit#033.dst: あら、ごめんなさい、気づかなかったわ。{u} のお友達かしら？
Queen's Recruit#033.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#034.src: I am! We arrived in Wynn on the same caravan. I'm Tasim.
Queen's Recruit#034.dst: うん！Wynn へは同じ馬車で来たんだ。僕は Tasim。
Queen's Recruit#034.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#036.src: So you're the one Aledar was always talking about! I thought you were off in Gavel?
Queen's Recruit#036.dst: じゃあお前が Aledar がいつも話してたやつか！Gavel に行ってたんじゃないのか？
Queen's Recruit#036.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#037.src: I... was. How do you all know him?
Queen's Recruit#037.dst: 僕は… 行ってた。みんなはどうして彼を？
Queen's Recruit#037.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#038.src: I believe we first met on a mission to reclaim {p}'s barracks from a treasonous commander. We've run into each other a few times since.
Queen's Recruit#038.dst: 初めて会ったのは、{p} の兵舎を反逆した指揮官から取り戻す任務だったと思う。それから何度か顔を合わせたわ。
Queen's Recruit#038.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#039.src: Still, it's good to finally get t' meet you! We've heard lots of stories! Including somethin' about not respondin' to letters...?
Queen's Recruit#039.dst: とにかく、やっと会えて嬉しいよ！話はたくさん聞いてる！手紙に返事しないとか何とか…？
Queen's Recruit#039.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#040.src: Oh... right. We, uh... sorted that out.
Queen's Recruit#040.dst: あ… うん。それは、その… 解決したよ。
Queen's Recruit#040.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#041.src: But speaking of have any of you seen him recently?
Queen's Recruit#041.dst: それより… 最近誰か彼を見た？
Queen's Recruit#041.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#042.src: 'fraid not. I don't think our paths've crossed since... was it the siege at {p}? Must've been.
Queen's Recruit#042.dst: 残念ながら。最後に会ったのは… {p} の包囲戦だったかな？たぶんそう。
Queen's Recruit#042.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#043.src: I saw him a month ago in {p}! I asked him what he was working on and if I could help and he just brushed me off. Weird, right?
Queen's Recruit#043.dst: 一か月前に {p} で見たぞ！何してるのか、手伝えるか聞いたらあしらわれた。変だろ？
Queen's Recruit#043.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#044.src: Mmn. No, that sounds like him. I think he had enough of your antics last time.
Queen's Recruit#044.dst: ふむ。いいえ、彼らしいわ。前回あなたの悪ふざけに懲りたのよ。
Queen's Recruit#044.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#045.src: What?! I'm capable. C'mon, Mel, tell her I'm capable.
Queen's Recruit#045.dst: 何だと？！俺は有能だ。なあ Mel、俺は有能だって言ってくれよ。
Queen's Recruit#045.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#046.src: Linton, y'were just tellin' us about how you caved in a whole temple by
Queen's Recruit#046.dst: Linton、あんたさっき神殿をまるごと崩した話を
Queen's Recruit#046.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#047.src: Okay! Okay, okay okay, let's talk about literally anything else! Tasim, right? What's... uh...
Queen's Recruit#047.dst: わかった！わかったわかった、他の話にしよう、何でもいい！Tasim だっけ？その… えーと…
Queen's Recruit#047.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#048.src: ...so, your... no, no, give me a moment you were... and... um... oh, right...
Queen's Recruit#048.dst: …で、お前の… いや待て、ちょっと待って、お前は… で… えーと… あ、そうだ…
Queen's Recruit#048.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#051.src: Linton!! Y'can't just ask someone that!!
Queen's Recruit#051.dst: Linton！！いきなり聞くことじゃないよ！！
Queen's Recruit#051.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#053.src: It was nice meeting you, Tasim. I look forward to working with you during this mission.
Queen's Recruit#053.dst: 会えてよかったわ、Tasim。この任務で一緒に働けるのを楽しみにしてる。
Queen's Recruit#053.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#054.src: ...likewise. It's always nice meeting friends of Aledar.
Queen's Recruit#054.dst: …こちらこそ。Aledar の友達に会えるのはいつも嬉しいよ。
Queen's Recruit#054.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#055.src: Well, look at you! It's been quite a time since we last spoke. Far above the task of cleaning out sewers now, eh?
Queen's Recruit#055.dst: おう、見違えたな！最後に話してからずいぶん経つ。もう下水掃除なんぞする身分じゃないな？
Queen's Recruit#055.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#056.src: I've heard some tell of your accomplishments. Fine work, fine work.
Queen's Recruit#056.dst: お前の活躍は耳にしてる。見事、見事だ。
Queen's Recruit#056.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#057.src: And... hm. Aren't you the one who ran off to Gavel without sayin' a word? Didn't expect you to be one o' the ones picked out for this.
Queen's Recruit#057.dst: それに… ふむ。お前は何も言わずに Gavel へ出ていったやつじゃないか？今回選ばれるとは思わなかったぞ。
Queen's Recruit#057.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#058.src: I... didn't expect it either. I didn't even realize the King still remembered me, truth be told.
Queen's Recruit#058.dst: 僕も… 思ってなかった。正直、王様が僕を覚えてるとも思わなかった。
Queen's Recruit#058.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#059.src: Mmn. Well, whatever the reason, you're here now. Don't suppose it matters much the path you took to get here. We need all the folks we can get or so Kymer's been sayin'.
Queen's Recruit#059.dst: ふむ。まあ理由はどうあれ、今はここにいる。どういう道でたどり着いたかは大して問題じゃない。今は人手がいくらでも要る… と Kymer が言ってた。
Queen's Recruit#059.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#060.src: Well well! If my eyes don't deceive me! {u} and Tasim!
Queen's Recruit#060.dst: おやおや！見間違いでなければ！{u} と Tasim ではないか！
Queen's Recruit#060.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#061.src: I'll say, I didn't quite expect them to track you down! What with your... extended stint off in Gavel.
Queen's Recruit#061.dst: いやはや、君たちを探し出せるとは思わなかった！なにせ Gavel での… 長い滞在があったからな。
Queen's Recruit#061.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#062.src: I should say the same about you, captain. Did {p} no longer have a use for you once the war ended?
Queen's Recruit#062.dst: それはこっちのセリフだよ、隊長。戦争が終わって {p} では用済みになったのかい？
Queen's Recruit#062.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#063.src: Ah... nothing of the sort. You know, I was sent out there initially to serve as more of an envoy from {p}! If the King needs a diplomatic situation sorted, I'm the one he turns to first.
Queen's Recruit#063.dst: ああ… そんなことはない。そもそも私はあちらへ {p} の使節として派遣されたのだよ！王が外交問題を片付けたいとき、真っ先に頼るのがこの私だ。
Queen's Recruit#063.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#064.src: Which... is indeed why I am here now. I was recalled rather abruptly several weeks ago. It seems we've entered a tricky situation with our... neighboring province.
Queen's Recruit#064.dst: だからこそ… 今ここにいるわけだ。数週間前、突然呼び戻されてね。どうやら我々は… 隣の地方と厄介な状況にあるらしい。
Queen's Recruit#064.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#065.src: But! I shan't say more before the King arrives. He'll tell you all of the problem that hopefully we will be able to resolve.
Queen's Recruit#065.dst: だが！王がお見えになるまでは何も言うまい。問題はすべて王が話してくださる。解決できるといいのだが。
Queen's Recruit#065.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#066.src: ...I see. We'll leave you to it, then.
Queen's Recruit#066.dst: …なるほど。じゃあ僕たちはこれで。
Queen's Recruit#066.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#067.src: If we align the manaflow with Water, then nudge it to the side, maybe... ah Reynauld, pass me my notes on... damn, what was it oh, yes, the recovery period! Pass me those ones.
Queen's Recruit#067.dst: マナの流れを水に合わせて、横に少しずらせば、あるいは… ああ Reynauld、例のメモを… くそ、何だったか… そうだ、回復期間だ！あれを取ってくれ。
Queen's Recruit#067.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#068.src: ...You already have them on your left, doctor.
Queen's Recruit#068.dst: …博士、それならもう左手に持っていますよ。
Queen's Recruit#068.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#069.src: Do I now! It seems I do... oh, but this is only the first half where did I leave the rest...
Queen's Recruit#069.dst: そうかね！確かに… おや、だがこれは前半だけだ… 残りはどこに置いたか…
Queen's Recruit#069.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#070.src: Sigh... If you'd just allow me to organize for you, maybe you wouldn't
Queen's Recruit#070.dst: はあ… 整理を任せてくれれば、こんなことには
Queen's Recruit#070.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#071.src: And ruin my predefined sorting system?! No, Reynauld, I do think it works perfectly well as it is, thank you very much! Now, where could it have
Queen's Recruit#071.dst: そして私の独自の分類法を台無しにしろと？！いや Reynauld、今のままで完璧に機能しているとも、どうもありがとう！さて、どこに
Queen's Recruit#071.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#072.src: Ah! You two! Good, good, you're here I was worried Reynauld would be the only other one with recovered memories around here!
Queen's Recruit#072.dst: おお！君たち！よし、よく来た… ここで記憶を取り戻した者が Reynauld だけかと心配していたんだ！
Queen's Recruit#072.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#073.src: What, you didn't test it on anyone else after we left?
Queen's Recruit#073.dst: えっ、僕たちが去ったあと、他の誰にも試さなかったの？
Queen's Recruit#073.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#074.src: Test it on no, of course not! After what I saw? No, no, that would certainly not have been worth the risk. No new test subjects until I am certain it's flawless!
Queen's Recruit#074.dst: 他人に試す… まさか！あんなものを見た後で？いやいや、そんな危険は冒せない。完璧だと確信するまで新しい被験者はなしだ！
Queen's Recruit#074.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#075.src: I've been using it on myself instead! And, let me tell you the breakthroughs I have made... there is much to be learned.
Queen's Recruit#075.dst: 代わりに自分自身に使っているのだよ！しかも聞いてくれ、私が成し遂げた発見を… 学ぶべきことは山ほどある。
Queen's Recruit#075.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#076.dst: それって… 安全なの？
Queen's Recruit#076.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#077.src: Pah! "Safety" a meaningless term made only to stifle progress. Have there been side effects certainly! But it has all been worth it.
Queen's Recruit#077.dst: ふん！「安全」… 進歩を妨げるためだけの無意味な言葉だ。副作用は… もちろんあった！だが全て報われたよ。
Queen's Recruit#077.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#078.src: Now, I must return to the pages... I've some equations I need to perfect before the King arrives...
Queen's Recruit#078.dst: さて、書類に戻らねば… 王がお見えになる前に仕上げたい式があるのでね…
Queen's Recruit#078.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#079.src: Hm. I can't say I would have expected you to be here, Tasim.
Queen's Recruit#079.dst: ふむ。君がここにいるとは思わなかったよ、Tasim。
Queen's Recruit#079.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#080.src: Well... fate has other plans, I guess. How about you? Did you stay in {p}?
Queen's Recruit#080.dst: まあ… 運命は別の計画を用意してたみたい。君は？ずっと {p} にいたの？
Queen's Recruit#080.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#081.src: Mostly. Moved around for a few assignments here and there, but I kept coming back.
Queen's Recruit#081.dst: ほとんどね。任務であちこち移ったこともあるが、結局いつも戻ってきた。
Queen's Recruit#081.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#082.src: ...we haven't spoken in a while. Are you... doing well? How have you been managing the memories?
Queen's Recruit#082.dst: …しばらく話していなかったな。元気か…？記憶とはどう折り合いをつけている？
Queen's Recruit#082.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#084.src: As well as I could be expected to, I guess. It was rough for the first few months. Eventually, I got used to it.
Queen's Recruit#084.dst: まあ、それなりにね。最初の数か月はきつかった。そのうち慣れたよ。
Queen's Recruit#084.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#085.src: How about you? I also wouldn't have expected you to show for a mission like this.
Queen's Recruit#085.dst: 君はどう？こんな任務に君が来るとも思わなかった。
Queen's Recruit#085.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#086.src: Same as you. Helped that Caid and I managed to talk it through. We meet every so often, talk about it. He talks about his sister, how he wants to find her one day.
Queen's Recruit#086.dst: 君と同じさ。Caid と話し合えたのが助けになった。時々会って、そのことを話すんだ。彼は妹の話をする。いつか見つけ出したいと。
Queen's Recruit#086.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#087.dst: それは… よかった。嬉しいよ。
Queen's Recruit#087.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#088.src: Hm. Nothing stopping you from stopping by, yourself. It might even help you.
Queen's Recruit#088.dst: ふむ。君も顔を出したらいい。助けになるかもしれない。
Queen's Recruit#088.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#089.src: I'll... consider it. Good to see you again, Reynauld.
Queen's Recruit#089.dst: 考えて… おくよ。また会えてよかった、Reynauld。
Queen's Recruit#089.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#090.src: Another soldier? Allow me to see your summons.
Queen's Recruit#090.dst: また兵士か？召集状を見せてもらおう。
Queen's Recruit#090.speaker: Ragni Guard

Queen's Recruit#091.src: ...good. Come on in, {u}. The King will be arriving shortly.
Queen's Recruit#091.dst: …よし。入れ、{u}。王はまもなくお見えになる。
Queen's Recruit#091.speaker: Ragni Guard

Queen's Recruit#093.src: If you insist. Don't take too long.
Queen's Recruit#093.dst: どうしてもと言うなら。長くかかるなよ。
Queen's Recruit#093.speaker: Ragni Guard

Queen's Recruit#094.src: Ah... here we are. I thank you all for coming on such short notice. It has been some time since I have seen many of you.
Queen's Recruit#094.dst: ああ… そろったな。急な呼び出しにもかかわらず来てくれて感謝する。多くの者と会うのは久しぶりだ。
Queen's Recruit#094.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#095.src: ...I'll get right to the point. We find ourselves in a very delicate position when it comes to relations with our neighboring province, Fruma.
Queen's Recruit#095.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#096.src: We rely heavily on the flow of new recruits sent to us, but we have no means of contacting their province. Only they may reach out to us, and only once they have chosen to do so.
Queen's Recruit#096.dst: 我々は送られてくる新兵に大きく頼っているが、あちらと連絡を取る手段がない。向こうから、向こうがそう決めたときにしか接触できぬのだ。
Queen's Recruit#096.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#097.src: ...several weeks ago, we received a cloaked visitor through the outskirts. She claimed to be of Fruma, one of their Sovereigns.
Queen's Recruit#097.dst: …数週間前、外れからフードをかぶった訪問者が来た。Fruma の者で、君主の一人だと名乗った。
Queen's Recruit#097.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#098.src: We were extended an invitation, of sorts. Of all the recruits we have ever received, we were to select the greatest, and send them into Fruma for some sort of celebration.
Queen's Recruit#098.dst: 我々はいわば招待を受けた。これまで受け入れた新兵の中から最も優れた者を選び、Fruma での何かの祝典に送れというのだ。
Queen's Recruit#098.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#099.src: Is that who we are? The greatest?
Queen's Recruit#099.dst: それが僕たち？最も優れた？
Queen's Recruit#099.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#100.src: The ones that could be reached, at the very least! Perhaps some were greater yet, but we all know the roaming habits of your sort, and tracking them down really can prove
Queen's Recruit#100.dst: 少なくとも連絡がついた中ではな！もっと優れた者もいたかもしれんが、君たちのような者の放浪癖は周知の通り、探し出すのは実に
Queen's Recruit#100.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#101.src: Ugh, we're not going along with this, are we?
Queen's Recruit#101.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#103.src: What? They're demanding something weird and obviously suspicious, so why should we just accept it?
Queen's Recruit#103.dst: 何だよ？怪しさ満点の妙な要求をしてきてるんだぞ、なんでそのまま受けなきゃならないんだ？
Queen's Recruit#103.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#104.src: I'm afraid we don't have a choice in the matter. As I mentioned, the recruits we receive make all the difference in our province's continued survival. If we were to reject this invitation...
Queen's Recruit#104.dst: 残念だが、我々に選択の余地はない。言った通り、受け入れる新兵はこの地方の存続を左右する。もしこの招待を断れば…
Queen's Recruit#104.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#105.src: ...who's to say they wouldn't just stop sendin' 'em, eh? Tough.
Queen's Recruit#105.dst: …向こうが送るのをやめない保証はない、ってわけか。厳しいな。
Queen's Recruit#105.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#106.src: Besides all that, think of the opportunity this presents! A true, freely-given view of what lies beyond those walls! We'd be fools not to accept it, no matter the implied threat!
Queen's Recruit#106.dst: それに、この好機を考えてみたまえ！あの壁の向こうを、正式に招かれて見られるのだ！脅しがあろうと、受けないのは愚か者だけだ！
Queen's Recruit#106.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#107.src: Indeed. I regret that I must request this of you... but there is no other choice. You must accept this invitation.
Queen's Recruit#107.dst: その通りだ。こんな頼みをせねばならぬのは心苦しいが… 他に道はない。この招待を受けてくれ。
Queen's Recruit#107.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#108.src: ...even those of us with bad experiences of the province?
Queen's Recruit#108.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#109.src: I apologize... but you must. My hands are tied.
Queen's Recruit#109.dst: すまぬ… だが行ってもらわねばならん。私にはどうにもできぬのだ。
Queen's Recruit#109.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#110.src: I take it we are expected to gather as much intelligence on Fruma as we can while we're in there?
Queen's Recruit#110.dst: つまり、中にいる間に Fruma の情報をできる限り集めろということね？
Queen's Recruit#110.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#111.src: That's the plan, indeed! I'll explain more once we're there, but I believe we're on a time limit, correct?
Queen's Recruit#111.dst: まさにその通り！詳しくは向こうで説明するが、確か時間制限があるのでしたな？
Queen's Recruit#111.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#112.src: You are correct, doctor. I have been told that a representative will greet you all at the royal gates of Fruma, situated on the western coast.
Queen's Recruit#112.dst: その通りだ、博士。西岸にある Fruma の王家の門で、代表者が皆を出迎えると聞いている。
Queen's Recruit#112.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#113.src: I've sent a courier ahead to {p} to inform the local captains of the destination they are to take you to.
Queen's Recruit#113.dst: {p} へ先に使いを出し、地元の船長たちに行き先を伝えてある。
Queen's Recruit#113.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#114.src: {p}... I know a captain there. {u}, want to join me?
Queen's Recruit#114.dst: {p}… そこに知り合いの船長がいるんだ。{u}、一緒に来る？
Queen's Recruit#114.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#115.src: Finally... a glimpse at the province's inner workings... how long have I been seeking these answers?
Queen's Recruit#115.dst: ついに… あの地方の内情を垣間見られる… この答えをどれほど探し求めてきたことか？
Queen's Recruit#115.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#116.src: So many theories... how many will be proven right? How many will be wrong? I cannot wait to find out!
Queen's Recruit#116.dst: 数々の仮説… いくつが正しく、いくつが間違っているのか？知るのが待ちきれない！
Queen's Recruit#116.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#117.src: Sigh... I did know this was coming. Why else would the doctor have been summoned? But I hoped I was wrong.
Queen's Recruit#117.dst: はあ… こうなるとわかっていた。でなければ博士が呼ばれるはずがない。だが外れてほしかった。
Queen's Recruit#117.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#118.src: Tough situation, isn't it? Lots o' secrecy on part of the Frumans...
Queen's Recruit#118.dst: 厄介な状況だろう？Fruma の連中は隠し事だらけだ…
Queen's Recruit#118.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#119.src: But we'll handle it. Everyone here's plenty capable, after all.
Queen's Recruit#119.dst: だがなんとかなる。ここにいるのは腕利きばかりだからな。
Queen's Recruit#119.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#120.src: Hm... what a situation it is we find ourselves in! Diplomacy is my specialty, of course, but my expertise has not prepared me for... this.
Queen's Recruit#120.dst: ふむ… 実に厄介な状況に置かれたものだ！外交は私の専門だが、私の経験もこれには… 備えがない。
Queen's Recruit#120.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#121.src: Fruma knows what they want, and know they are strong enough that they can afford to let up their position.
Queen's Recruit#121.dst: Fruma は望みをわかっているし、交渉を降りても困らぬほど強いと承知している。
Queen's Recruit#121.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#122.src: Another top secret mission already? And I'm not even allowed to bring my explosives?
Queen's Recruit#122.dst: また極秘任務かよ？しかも爆薬の持ち込みも禁止？
Queen's Recruit#122.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#123.src: It's interesting, at least! Way better than that last assignment...
Queen's Recruit#123.dst: まあ、面白くはあるな！前の任務よりずっとマシだ…
Queen's Recruit#123.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#124.src: This mission's a big deal, huh? Lot's o' strong folks recalled for it, at least.
Queen's Recruit#124.dst: 今回の任務は大ごとだね？少なくとも強い人がたくさん呼び戻されてる。
Queen's Recruit#124.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#125.src: Makes me a bit nervous, honestly!
Queen's Recruit#125.dst: 正直、ちょっと緊張するよ！
Queen's Recruit#125.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#126.src: Fruma... I can't say it's been on my mind much. It's a mystery, yes, but not one with any available answers.
Queen's Recruit#126.dst: Fruma… あまり考えたことはなかった。謎ではあるけど、答えの得られない謎だもの。
Queen's Recruit#126.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#127.src: Well, until now, I suppose. I'll have to prepare a list of details to look out for...
Queen's Recruit#127.dst: まあ、今までは、ね。注意すべき点のリストを作っておかないと…
Queen's Recruit#127.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#128.src: And yet again, I must send you all into danger... a different sort, this time around, but danger nonetheless.
Queen's Recruit#128.dst: またしても、皆を危険へ送り出さねばならぬ… 今回は種類が違うが、危険には変わりない。
Queen's Recruit#128.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#129.src: I remember each face which passes through my castle. I rarely see any of them again.
Queen's Recruit#129.dst: この城を通った顔はすべて覚えている。再び会えることはめったにないが。
Queen's Recruit#129.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#130.src: But this time... I have faith we will meet once more. Go on, young hero. Your mission lies ahead of you.
Queen's Recruit#130.dst: だが今回は… また会えると信じている。行け、若き英雄よ。使命は君の前にある。
Queen's Recruit#130.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#131.src: ...back to Fruma. I've only just come back to Wynn, and now...
Queen's Recruit#131.dst: …Fruma に戻る。Wynn に帰ってきたばかりなのに…
Queen's Recruit#131.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#132.src: But it had to happen eventually. And I do want answers. So... in we go.
Queen's Recruit#132.dst: でもいつかはこうなるはずだった。答えも知りたいし。だから… 行こう。
Queen's Recruit#132.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#133.src: I'll be heading to the {p} Seaskipper, if you want to tag along.
Queen's Recruit#133.dst: {p} の Seaskipper に向かうよ、ついて来るならどうぞ。
Queen's Recruit#133.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#134.src: Travel to the Gate of Fruma at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] or meet up with Tasim in {p}.
Queen's Recruit#134.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Fruma の門へ行くか、{p} で Tasim と合流する。

Queen's Recruit#135.src: ...Oh! You're here! Lost in thought, sorry.
Queen's Recruit#135.dst: …あっ！来てたんだ！ごめん、考え事してた。
Queen's Recruit#135.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#136.src: It's all a little surreal, isn't it? I only just got back to Wynn, and now... Fruma!
Queen's Recruit#136.dst: なんだか現実味がないよね？Wynn に戻ったばかりなのに… 今度は Fruma！
Queen's Recruit#136.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#137.src: Kind of make me wish we had Aledar here too. The three of us on an adventure again! Going back... home...
Queen's Recruit#137.dst: Aledar もここにいればな。また三人で冒険だ！故郷に… 帰るんだ…
Queen's Recruit#137.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#138.src: I guess we'll just have to tell him all about it when we get back. He'll be sad he missed it, I bet.
Queen's Recruit#138.dst: 帰ったら全部話してあげないとね。見逃したって残念がるだろうな。
Queen's Recruit#138.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#139.src: Oi, there! Are those my two favorite customers I see?
Queen's Recruit#139.dst: おう、そこの！俺のお気に入りの客が二人も来たか？
Queen's Recruit#139.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#140.src: You call everyone your favorite customer, captain! Don't think I didn't notice!
Queen's Recruit#140.dst: 船長は誰にでもお気に入りって言うじゃないか！気づいてないと思った？
Queen's Recruit#140.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#141.src: Eheheheh, well, it's true, ain't it? I got lots o' favorites! Ah, anyhow, you're here for a trip, ain't'cha?
Queen's Recruit#141.dst: えへへへ、でも本当だろ？お気に入りはたくさんいるのさ！ああ、とにかく、船に乗りに来たんだろ？
Queen's Recruit#141.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#142.src: We are! You've... probably heard the details already? There should have been something about a new destination.
Queen's Recruit#142.dst: そうなんだ！たぶん… もう詳しい話は聞いてる？新しい行き先の話があったはずなんだけど。
Queen's Recruit#142.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#143.src: Aye. That I have. Some scrawny {p} courier wooshed past earlier! I barely got a word in before he was off again! Real interesting fellow.
Queen's Recruit#143.dst: ああ。聞いてるとも。さっき痩せっぽちの {p} の使いがびゅーんと通っていったぜ！一言返す間もなく行っちまった！面白い奴だ。
Queen's Recruit#143.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#144.src: ... Not a part o' the sea I like to visit, but I reckon I can make an exception this time.
Queen's Recruit#144.dst: …あまり行きたくない海域だが、今回は特別だ。
Queen's Recruit#144.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#145.src: Hm... I can pay you extra for the trip, if you'd like.
Queen's Recruit#145.dst: うーん… よければ、運賃を多めに払うよ。
Queen's Recruit#145.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#146.src: Ha! No, no, there's no need for that. It's free of charge for my two favorite customers, eheh!
Queen's Recruit#146.dst: はっ！いやいや、その必要はない。お気に入りの二人はタダだ、えへへ！
Queen's Recruit#146.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#147.src: ...and, 'course, s'all paid for from {p}'s royal coffers anyhow. Now, hop on abour 'fore I change my mind and leave without ya!
Queen's Recruit#147.dst: …それにまあ、どうせ {p} の王家の金庫持ちだしな。さあ、気が変わって置いてく前に乗った乗った！
Queen's Recruit#147.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#149.dst: …あっ！来てたんだ！ごめん、考え事してた。
