Queen's Recruit#161.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#163.src: ...so, Fruma, eh? I'd ask what business ya've got there, but... figure it's top secret.
Queen's Recruit#163.dst: …で、Fruma か？何の用か聞きたいところだが… 極秘なんだろうな。
Queen's Recruit#163.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#164.src: We've been... invited into the province. Supposedly, it's for some sort of celebration, but...
Queen's Recruit#164.dst: 僕たちは… あの地方に招かれたんだ。何かの祝典らしいけど…
Queen's Recruit#164.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#165.src: Mmn. Aye, knowin' the rumors... not the kind o' place to just invite folks in, is it?
Queen's Recruit#165.dst: ふむ。ああ、噂を聞く限り… 気軽に人を招く場所じゃないよな？
Queen's Recruit#165.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#168.src: Tell me, what's on yer mind then? The both o' you. Speakin' thoughts out tends to make 'em easier to manage, in my experience.
Queen's Recruit#168.dst: なら、何を考えてるか話してみな。二人ともだ。俺の経験じゃ、口に出すと気持ちの整理がつきやすい。
Queen's Recruit#168.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#169.src: Fruma went through all that trouble to erase our memories, to get rid of us... just to ask for us back out of nowhere.
Queen's Recruit#169.dst: Fruma は僕たちの記憶を消して、追い出すためにあれだけ手間をかけたのに… 突然呼び戻すなんて。
Queen's Recruit#169.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#170.src: I don't know why they're doing it, but I'm worried there's more going on.
Queen's Recruit#170.dst: 理由はわからないけど、裏に何かある気がして不安なんだ。
Queen's Recruit#170.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#171.src: I've not got more of a clue than either o' you, but I reckon that suspicion is warranted.
Queen's Recruit#171.dst: 俺もお前らと同じで見当もつかんが、疑うのはもっともだと思うぜ。
Queen's Recruit#171.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#172.src: But don't let it consume you, aye? Some suspicion is healthy, but if it colors everything ya do, it'll hurt ya just as bad as naivety would. Keep an open mind.
Queen's Recruit#172.dst: だが疑いに呑まれるなよ？多少の疑いは健全だが、何もかもそれで染まっちまったら、世間知らずと同じくらい自分を傷つける。心は広く持て。
Queen's Recruit#172.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#173.src: ...it's possible. I hope you're right, and it is all fine, and we are all overthinking it...
Queen's Recruit#173.dst: …かもしれない。船長の言う通りで、何も問題なくて、僕たちの考えすぎだといいけど…
Queen's Recruit#173.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#174.src: But I can't let my guard down. Everything about this situation is screaming that something isn't right, and... I don't know what.
Queen's Recruit#174.dst: でも油断はできない。この状況の何もかもが、何かおかしいって叫んでる。でも… それが何かわからない。
Queen's Recruit#174.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#175.src: Nothin' wrong with hopin' for the best. Stayin' positive is all ya can really do, sometimes.
Queen's Recruit#175.dst: 最善を願うのは悪いことじゃない。前向きでいるしかないときもあるさ。
Queen's Recruit#175.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#176.src: Out here on the sea, we have a saying... go searchin' for the storm, and it'll find ya itself. Don't expect the worst, or it'll find a way to come to pass.
Queen's Recruit#176.dst: 海の上じゃこう言うんだ… 嵐を探しに行けば、嵐のほうからやって来る。最悪を予想するな、でなきゃ本当になる。
Queen's Recruit#176.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#177.src: ...home? Home. I guess. It'll be nice to have more memories of it than just... you know. Curses, and all that.
Queen's Recruit#177.dst: …故郷？故郷。そうかもね。記憶が… ほら、呪いとかそういうのだけじゃなくなるなら、いいかも。
Queen's Recruit#177.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#178.src: Hm. I don’t got much of a home to get back to, either. Had it taken from me by those I trusted, eheh!
Queen's Recruit#178.dst: ふむ。俺にも帰る故郷なんてないさ。信じてた奴らに奪われちまった、えへへ！
Queen's Recruit#178.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#179.src: ... But, I made my own home, out here on the sea. Think even if I could go back now, I wouldn’t!
Queen's Recruit#179.dst: …だがな、この海の上に自分の家を作った。今帰れるとしても、帰らないだろうな！
Queen's Recruit#179.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#180.src: So, if y’don’t like what ya find... don’t feel forced to take it, y’hear?
Queen's Recruit#180.dst: だから、向こうで見たものが気に入らなきゃ… 無理に受け入れるなよ、いいな？
Queen's Recruit#180.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#181.src: ...I'll keep that in mind. Thank you, captain.
Queen's Recruit#181.dst: …覚えておくよ。ありがとう、船長。
Queen's Recruit#181.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#182.src: Ah, it's what I'm here for, ain't it? Givin' sage advice and salin' folks around the sea!
Queen's Recruit#182.dst: ああ、それが俺の役目だろ？ありがたい助言をして、人を海の向こうへ運ぶのさ！
Queen's Recruit#182.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#183.src: And look at that, on the horizon! Shinin' opulent docks... seems we've arrived.
Queen's Recruit#183.dst: ほら見ろ、水平線だ！輝く豪華な港… 着いたようだな。
Queen's Recruit#183.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#184.src: Dunno what you'll be facin' in there... but good luck anyway, aye?
Queen's Recruit#184.dst: 中で何が待ってるか知らんが… とにかく幸運をな？
Queen's Recruit#184.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#185.src: We'll need it. Thanks for bringing us here, captain.
Queen's Recruit#185.dst: 必要になりそうだ。連れてきてくれてありがとう、船長。
Queen's Recruit#185.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#187.src: It's... impressive. To build something like this for a gate no one ever uses...
Queen's Recruit#187.dst: これは… すごいね。誰も使わない門のためにこんなものを建てるなんて…
Queen's Recruit#187.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#188.src: I guess they have the resources to spare.
Queen's Recruit#188.dst: 資源が有り余ってるんだろうね。
Queen's Recruit#188.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#189.src: Meet up with the group at the gate at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Queen's Recruit#190.src: Finally! The stragglers arrive. You certainly took your time, didn't you?
Queen's Recruit#190.dst: やっとか！遅れ組のご到着だ。ずいぶんのんびりしていたな？
Queen's Recruit#190.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#192.src: Not the time, Kymer. Leave the poor man be for an hour, eh? Got bigger fish to fry, n' all that.
Queen's Recruit#192.dst: 今はよせ、Kymer。一時間くらい放っておいてやれ。もっと大事なことがあるだろう。
Queen's Recruit#192.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#193.src: Yes, yes, fine. We've not been able to get a word out of any of these soldiers! Do we even have the right time and place?
Queen's Recruit#193.dst: わかった、わかったとも。ここの兵士からは一言も聞き出せん！そもそも時間と場所は合っているのか？
Queen's Recruit#193.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#194.src: Nah, you just haven't been trying hard enough. Hey, tin can! This is Fruma, right?
Queen's Recruit#194.dst: いや、あんたの努力が足りないだけさ。おい、ブリキ缶！ここ Fruma だよな？
Queen's Recruit#194.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#196.dst: うわ。やっぱりあんたの言う通りだった。
Queen's Recruit#196.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#197.dst: 私はたいてい正しいのだ！
Queen's Recruit#197.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#198.src: It really is an impressive construction, isn't it? All this for a closed-off province.
Queen's Recruit#198.dst: 本当に見事な建造物ね。閉ざされた地方のために、これほどのものを。
Queen's Recruit#198.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#199.src: Impressive or not, we have work to do! On your guard, everyone. We don't know what to expect, so watch your backs.
Queen's Recruit#199.dst: 見事だろうとなかろうと、仕事がある！皆、警戒を。何が起こるかわからん、背後に気をつけたまえ。
Queen's Recruit#199.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#200.src: S'anyone's guess when they'll actually let us in...
Queen's Recruit#200.dst: いつ中に入れてくれるのか、見当もつかないね…
Queen's Recruit#200.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#203.src: Soldiers of Wynn! Her Majesty welcomes you to the province, as guests of the crown!
Queen's Recruit#203.dst: Wynn の兵士たちよ！女王陛下は王家の客人として、諸君を我が地方に歓迎する！
Queen's Recruit#203.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#204.src: Follow me, and you will be escorted to the royal palace. Let's not keep her waiting you all are of great importance to her.
Queen's Recruit#204.dst: ついて来い、王宮まで案内する。陛下を待たせるな… 諸君は陛下にとって非常に重要な存在だ。
Queen's Recruit#204.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#205.src: Listen to the introduction. Go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to return to the palace.
Queen's Recruit#205.dst: 紹介を聞く。王宮に戻るには [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] へ。

Queen's Recruit#206.src: Fruma's... a lot bigger than what I saw in my memories...
Queen's Recruit#206.dst: Fruma って… 記憶で見たよりずっと大きいな…
Queen's Recruit#206.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#207.src: I guess that makes sense. I probably didn't travel much, back then. But... still.
Queen's Recruit#207.dst: 当然か。あの頃はあまり出歩かなかったんだろう。でも… それでもね。
Queen's Recruit#207.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#209.src: It... was. I don't know what I expected going in, but... it was stunning.
Queen's Recruit#209.dst: うん… そうだね。何を想像してたかわからないけど… 圧倒されたよ。
Queen's Recruit#209.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#210.src: Ha! Yeah, you know, I think you're right. It was impressive, but Gavel also has impressive sights.
Queen's Recruit#210.dst: はは！うん、そうだね、君の言う通りかも。見事だったけど、Gavel にもすごい景色はある。
Queen's Recruit#210.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#211.src: But let's not get distracted. The tour felt very... controlled. We were never let out of the carriages, and the Sovereign was keeping a watchful eye on us.
Queen's Recruit#211.dst: でも気をそらさないようにしよう。あの案内はすごく… 管理されてた。馬車から一度も降ろしてもらえなかったし、君主もずっと僕たちを見張ってた。
Queen's Recruit#211.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#212.src: I'm interested in what they're choosing not to show us...
Queen's Recruit#212.dst: 僕が気になるのは、彼らが見せないようにしてるものだ…
Queen's Recruit#212.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#214.dst: ようこそ、Wynn の兵士たち。
Queen's Recruit#214.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#215.src: It is my honor as Queen to facilitate your return to our wonderful province. Though long you have spent away, you will always remain children of Fruma!
Queen's Recruit#215.dst: 女王として、皆さんがこの素晴らしい地方へ戻る手助けができて光栄です。長く離れていても、皆さんは永遠に Fruma の子なのです！
Queen's Recruit#215.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#216.src: Your work to battle against the blight beyond our walls has been of great interest. You have certainly made our province proud.
Queen's Recruit#216.dst: 壁の外の災いと戦う皆さんの働きには、大いに注目してきました。皆さんは我が地方の誇りです。
Queen's Recruit#216.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#217.src: You must have questions on the nature of your summons. All will be revealed but first, allow me to introduce two of my wonderful Sovereigns.
Queen's Recruit#217.dst: 召集の理由について疑問がおありでしょう。すべて明かします… ですがまず、わたくしの優秀な君主を二人紹介しましょう。
Queen's Recruit#217.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#218.src: You heard my name, but let me introduce myself. I am
Queen's Recruit#218.dst: 名は聞いただろうが、改めて名乗ろう。私は
Queen's Recruit#218.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#219.src: Majin of House Thalas, the Morning Star, Sovereign of our fair {p}. It's a pleasure, dear soldiers, to join our Queen for this ceremony!
Queen's Recruit#219.dst: Thalas 家の Majin、明けの明星にして、麗しき {p} の君主だ。親愛なる兵士諸君、この式典に女王陛下とご一緒できて光栄だよ！
Queen's Recruit#219.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#221.src: ...Zhiraok Nasin, Sovereign of the {p}. The value of that title should speak for itself.
Queen's Recruit#221.dst: …Zhiraok Nasin、{p} の君主。この称号の価値は言うまでもない。
Queen's Recruit#221.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#222.src: Thank you, Sovereigns. These two, and the rest, are my council for ruling over our province. Each Sovereign is given governance over their own district, and works to serve the people there.
Queen's Recruit#222.dst: ありがとう、君主たち。この二人と他の者たちが、地方を治めるわたくしの評議会です。君主はそれぞれ自分の地区を任され、その民に尽くしています。
Queen's Recruit#222.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#223.src: There are others. Though none could attend this event they find themselves occupied with various assignments.
Queen's Recruit#223.dst: 他にもいますが、今回は誰も出席できませんでした… 皆さまざまな任務に就いているのです。
Queen's Recruit#223.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#224.src: Enough of the boring talk! It is time for the welcoming feast!
Queen's Recruit#224.dst: 堅苦しい話はここまで！歓迎の宴の時間です！
Queen's Recruit#224.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#225.src: We would like to share a taste of what our province has to deliver. Please find your way to the grand dining hall, situated just behind me.
Queen's Recruit#225.dst: 我が地方の味をぜひ味わっていただきたいのです。わたくしの後ろにある大食堂へお進みください。
Queen's Recruit#225.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#226.src: Head to the royal dining hall at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#226.dst: [-{~}, {~}, {~}] の王家の食堂へ向かう。

Queen's Recruit#227.src: Make your way to the dining hall, the Queen will be starting her speech soon.
Queen's Recruit#227.dst: 食堂へお進みください、女王陛下のお話がまもなく始まります。
Queen's Recruit#227.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#228.src: ...you can't even follow the order of operations while Her Majesty is watching?! What kind of expected value must the recruits ha
Queen's Recruit#228.dst: …陛下の御前で演算の順序すら守れんのか？！新兵の期待値がこれでは
Queen's Recruit#228.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#229.src: Now, now, Nasin, settle down. We wouldn't want to leave a poor impression on our guest, would we?
Queen's Recruit#229.dst: まあまあ、Nasin、落ち着きたまえ。客人に悪い印象を与えたくはないだろう？
Queen's Recruit#229.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#230.dst: 私の数列を遮るな、この偽善
Queen's Recruit#230.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#231.src: Oh, you. You should report to the dining hall with the remainder of your group.
Queen's Recruit#231.dst: ああ、お前か。仲間と一緒に食堂へ行け。
Queen's Recruit#231.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#232.src: Yes, yes, move along. You certainly don't want to keep Her Majesty waiting!
Queen's Recruit#232.dst: そうそう、さっさと行きたまえ。女王陛下を待たせたくはないだろう！
Queen's Recruit#232.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#233.src: Well, I have put it off long enough. Before the first course is served, I will reveal the purpose of your presence here today.
Queen's Recruit#233.dst: さて、もう十分引き延ばしました。最初の料理が出る前に、皆さんが今日ここにいる目的を明かしましょう。
Queen's Recruit#233.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#234.src: In celebration of your work in the Wynn Province, we shall be hosting a tournament! You will all partake in a set of duels in order to crown the greatest soldier among you.
Queen's Recruit#234.dst: Wynn 地方での皆さんの働きを祝して、トーナメントを開催します！皆さんには一連の決闘に参加し、最強の兵士を決めていただきます。
Queen's Recruit#234.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#235.src: You have all grown in your time spent beyond our walls, and what better way to show it?
Queen's Recruit#235.dst: 壁の外で過ごす間に皆さんは成長しました。それを示すのにこれ以上の方法がありますか？
Queen's Recruit#235.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#236.src: We will, of course, provide compensation for all participants. A generous monetary reward shall be granted to each of you, no matter your placing in the tournament.
Queen's Recruit#236.dst: もちろん、参加者全員に報酬を用意します。順位にかかわらず、一人ひとりに十分な賞金を授けましょう。
Queen's Recruit#236.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#237.src: However, for whichever of you finds themselves crowned winner... a greater reward awaits. The specifics shall be revealed once the tournament has concluded.
Queen's Recruit#237.dst: ですが、優勝の栄冠を手にした者には… さらに大きな褒美が待っています。詳細はトーナメント終了後に明かします。
Queen's Recruit#237.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#238.src: Ah, your majesty if I may... I am not much of a fighter my specialty is in research and study of magic.
Queen's Recruit#238.dst: ああ、陛下… 失礼ながら、私は戦いが得意ではありません… 専門は魔法の研究でして。
Queen's Recruit#238.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#239.src: ...very well. Accommodations shall be made. A different request may be made of you later, in exchange.
Queen's Recruit#239.dst: …よろしい。配慮しましょう。代わりに、後ほど別のお願いをするかもしれません。
Queen's Recruit#239.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#240.src: I thank you for your grace and understanding, your majesty.
Queen's Recruit#240.dst: ご寛大なご理解に感謝いたします、陛下。
Queen's Recruit#240.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#241.src: Yes... now. Once the meal comes to a close, you shall all be assigned a room to stay in for the remainder of your stay in my palace.
Queen's Recruit#241.dst: ええ… では。食事が済んだら、宮殿に滞在する間の部屋を皆さんに割り当てます。
Queen's Recruit#241.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#242.src: Ah! It seems the first course has been prepared! Please, enjoy our province's finest cuisine.
Queen's Recruit#242.dst: あら！最初の料理ができたようです！どうぞ、我が地方の最高の料理をお楽しみください。
Queen's Recruit#242.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#243.src: ...I can't say I was expecting that, of all things.
Queen's Recruit#243.dst: …まさかそんな話になるとは思わなかった。
Queen's Recruit#243.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#244.src: You'll be joining the tournament, right?
Queen's Recruit#244.dst: 君はトーナメントに出るよね？
Queen's Recruit#244.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#246.src: We'd better get going and find our rooms everyone else headed south.
Queen's Recruit#246.dst: 早く行って部屋を探そう… みんな南へ行ったよ。
Queen's Recruit#246.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#247.src: Get your assigned room from the representative at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#247.dst: [-{~}, {~}, {~}] の代表者から部屋の割り当てを受ける。

Queen's Recruit#249.src: Your rooms are located on the east and west side of here.
Queen's Recruit#249.dst: 皆さんの部屋はここの東側と西側にあります。
Queen's Recruit#249.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#250.src: Your rooms are on the other side of the castle. Please make your way over there.
Queen's Recruit#250.dst: お部屋は城の反対側です。そちらへお進みください。
Queen's Recruit#250.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#255.src: Talk about a fancy feast, huh?
Queen's Recruit#255.dst: 豪勢なごちそうだったな？
Queen's Recruit#255.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#256.src: They're really pullin' out all the stops, huh? Don't think I've had anythin' that good in a long while.
Queen's Recruit#256.dst: 本当に出し惜しみなしだね？あんなにおいしいもの、久しぶりに食べたよ。
Queen's Recruit#256.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#257.src: Yeah, that was probably the best meal I've had in a long time... Really tired me out. Can't wait for a long and good rest.
Queen's Recruit#257.dst: うん、あんなにいい食事は久しぶりだったかも… おかげでくたくただ。ゆっくり休みたいな。
Queen's Recruit#257.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#258.src: Ah, there we are. Tasim and {u}, you'll be in room W3... in the western wing.
Queen's Recruit#258.dst: ああ、ありました。Tasim と {u}、西棟の W3 号室です。
Queen's Recruit#258.speaker: Representative

Queen's Recruit#259.src: How 'bout us? I'm Mel, and this is Linton.
Queen's Recruit#259.dst: あたしたちは？あたしは Mel、こっちは Linton。
Queen's Recruit#259.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#262.src: Mel and Lanu, you'll be in E2.
Queen's Recruit#262.dst: Mel と Lanu は E2 です。
Queen's Recruit#262.speaker: Representative

Queen's Recruit#263.src: Uh hey, I think you forgot someone! Where am I staying?
Queen's Recruit#263.dst: あの、おい、誰か忘れてないか！俺はどこに泊まるんだ？
Queen's Recruit#263.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#265.dst: えー…… ふむ…… おや……
Queen's Recruit#265.speaker: Representative

Queen's Recruit#266.src: Linton and Kymer are in W2.
Queen's Recruit#266.dst: Linton と Kymer は W2 です。
Queen's Recruit#266.speaker: Representative

Queen's Recruit#267.src: Oh... uh, Kymer, huh? That's... hm. Okay.
Queen's Recruit#267.dst: あ… えっと、Kymer と？それは… うーん。わかった。
Queen's Recruit#267.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#269.src: Head to your room, W-{~}, and check it out.
Queen's Recruit#269.dst: 自分の部屋 W-{~} へ行き、中を確かめる。

Queen's Recruit#270.src: Room W3... Now get going. I have a lot of rooms to assign...
Queen's Recruit#270.dst: W3 号室です… さあお行きなさい。割り当てる部屋がたくさんあるので…
Queen's Recruit#270.speaker: Representative

Queen's Recruit#271.src: I'm just gonna wait here for Lanu.
Queen's Recruit#271.dst: あたしはここで Lanu を待つよ。
Queen's Recruit#271.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#272.src: Hm... {u}? Think you've got the wrong room!
Queen's Recruit#272.dst: ふむ… {u}？部屋を間違えてるぞ！
Queen's Recruit#272.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#273.src: Odd that I've got a room all to myself... but eh, I won't complain.
Queen's Recruit#273.dst: 一人部屋ってのは妙だが… まあ文句は言わんさ。
Queen's Recruit#273.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#274.src: Kymer. Sure! Cool, cool cool cool... I can stay with the... big biceps... yep. That's... fine. That's fine. Good, even.
Queen's Recruit#274.dst: Kymer か。いいとも！いいね、いいいい… あの… でかい二の腕と一緒でも… うん。平気… 平気だ。むしろ最高。
Queen's Recruit#274.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#275.dst: じゃあ、ここが僕たちの部屋？
Queen's Recruit#275.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#276.src: It seems cozy enough, I guess... hard to relax, though, given... you know. all of it.
Queen's Recruit#276.dst: 居心地はよさそうだけど… くつろぐのは難しいね、だって… ほら。いろいろと。
Queen's Recruit#276.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#277.src: ...it's easier than I thought it would be, being in Fruma. There's enough distance from... the, uh, memories.
Queen's Recruit#277.dst: …Fruma にいるのは思ったより楽だ。あの… 記憶からは十分離れてるから。
Queen's Recruit#277.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#278.src: But, okay, we're in private now. So.. what do you actually think of the tournament? It's weird, right? Why would we be invited for this?
Queen's Recruit#278.dst: さて、今は二人きりだ。で… トーナメントのこと、本当はどう思う？変だよね？なんで僕たちがこのために招かれたんだろう？
Queen's Recruit#278.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#279.src: Me neither. I don't know what I was expecting when we were entering Fruma, but it wasn't... this.
Queen's Recruit#279.dst: 僕もだよ。Fruma に入るとき何を想像してたかわからないけど、こんなの… 予想外だ。
Queen's Recruit#279.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#280.src: I think we'll have to participate, but keep an eye out. Maybe the secret reward will have some answers..
Queen's Recruit#280.dst: 参加するしかないと思うけど、目は光らせておこう。秘密の褒美に答えがあるかも…
Queen's Recruit#280.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#281.src: Hm... you're probably right, I just don't know what it could possibly be.
Queen's Recruit#281.dst: うーん… たぶん君の言う通りだ、ただ何なのか見当もつかない。
Queen's Recruit#281.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#282.src: Maybe there's something going on with that secret reward for the winner... we'll have to wait and see, I guess.
Queen's Recruit#282.dst: 優勝者への秘密の褒美に何かあるのかも… 様子を見るしかないね。
Queen's Recruit#282.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#283.src: Ha! Yeah, alright. I'm a little excited, too. I haven't had any friendly duels for a long time, so maybe it'll be nice to test my strength.
Queen's Recruit#283.dst: はは！うん、わかったよ。僕もちょっとわくわくしてる。親善試合なんて久しぶりだし、力試しにはいいかも。
Queen's Recruit#283.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#284.src: But don’t forget why we’re here. Keep your guard up. Something about that reward she mentioned... it makes me uneasy.
Queen's Recruit#284.dst: でも、ここに来た理由を忘れないで。警戒は怠らずに。彼女が言ってた褒美… なんだか落ち着かないんだ。
Queen's Recruit#284.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#285.src: It strikes me as the kind of thing Aledar would enjoy. What better way to prove himself than to win this big tournament?
Queen's Recruit#285.dst: Aledar が喜びそうな話だよね。この大きなトーナメントで勝つ以上に、自分を証明する方法なんてある？
Queen's Recruit#285.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#286.src: He'd get to use all his potions and tricks, too! He's always telling me about the horrific creations he's mixed together.
Queen's Recruit#286.dst: 薬や小細工も全部使えるしね！彼はいつも、自分が混ぜ合わせた恐ろしい代物の話をするんだ。
Queen's Recruit#286.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#288.dst: じゃあ、ここが僕たちの部屋？
Queen's Recruit#288.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#289.src: It seems cozy enough, I guess... hard to relax, though, given... you know. all of it.
Queen's Recruit#289.dst: 居心地はよさそうだけど… くつろぐのは難しいね、だって… ほら。いろいろと。
Queen's Recruit#289.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#290.src: ...it's easier than I thought it would be, being in Fruma. There's enough distance from... the, uh, memories.
Queen's Recruit#290.dst: …Fruma にいるのは思ったより楽だ。あの… 記憶からは十分離れてるから。
Queen's Recruit#290.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#291.src: But, okay, we're in private now. So.. what do you actually think of the tournament? It's weird, right? Why would we be invited for this?
Queen's Recruit#291.dst: さて、今は二人きりだ。で… トーナメントのこと、本当はどう思う？変だよね？なんで僕たちがこのために招かれたんだろう？
Queen's Recruit#291.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#292.src: Me neither. I don't know what I was expecting when we were entering Fruma, but it wasn't... this.
Queen's Recruit#292.dst: 僕もだよ。Fruma に入るとき何を想像してたかわからないけど、こんなの… 予想外だ。
Queen's Recruit#292.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#293.src: I think we'll have to participate, but keep an eye out. Maybe the secret reward will have some answers..
Queen's Recruit#293.dst: 参加するしかないと思うけど、目は光らせておこう。秘密の褒美に答えがあるかも…
Queen's Recruit#293.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#294.src: Hm... you're probably right, I just don't know what it could possibly be.
Queen's Recruit#294.dst: うーん… たぶん君の言う通りだ、ただ何なのか見当もつかない。
Queen's Recruit#294.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#295.src: Maybe there's something going on with that secret reward for the winner... we'll have to wait and see, I guess.
Queen's Recruit#295.dst: 優勝者への秘密の褒美に何かあるのかも… 様子を見るしかないね。
Queen's Recruit#295.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#296.src: Ha! Yeah, alright. I'm a little excited, too. I haven't had any friendly duels for a long time, so maybe it'll be nice to test my strength.
Queen's Recruit#296.dst: はは！うん、わかったよ。僕もちょっとわくわくしてる。親善試合なんて久しぶりだし、力試しにはいいかも。
Queen's Recruit#296.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#297.src: But don’t forget why we’re here. Keep your guard up. Something about that reward she mentioned... it makes me uneasy.
Queen's Recruit#297.dst: でも、ここに来た理由を忘れないで。警戒は怠らずに。彼女が言ってた褒美… なんだか落ち着かないんだ。
Queen's Recruit#297.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#298.src: It strikes me as the kind of thing Aledar would enjoy. What better way to prove himself than to win this big tournament?
Queen's Recruit#298.dst: Aledar が喜びそうな話だよね。この大きなトーナメントで勝つ以上に、自分を証明する方法なんてある？
Queen's Recruit#298.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#299.src: He'd get to use all his potions and tricks, too! He's always telling me about the horrific creations he's mixed together.
Queen's Recruit#299.dst: 薬や小細工も全部使えるしね！彼はいつも、自分が混ぜ合わせた恐ろしい代物の話をするんだ。
Queen's Recruit#299.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#304.src: Oh, uh, nothing much. Just a secret meeting. In Jenprest's room that's W1, at the start of the corridor.
Queen's Recruit#304.dst: あ、いや、大したことじゃない。ただの秘密会議さ。Jenprest の部屋… 廊下の入口の W1 だ。
Queen's Recruit#304.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#305.src: Picard says we should talk about what we've got so far. He also said to space out people coming to the room so wait a few minutes before stopping by!
Queen's Recruit#305.dst: Picard が、今わかってることを話し合おうってさ。部屋に来るのは時間をずらせって… だから数分待ってから来てくれ！
Queen's Recruit#305.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#306.src: I... guess that makes sense. But why are you here, and not
Queen's Recruit#306.dst: それは… まあ、そうだね。でもなんで君が、他の
Queen's Recruit#306.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#307.src: 'Cause I'm fast and stealthy. Gotta run now, I don't want to draw the guards' attention. Remember, room W1!
Queen's Recruit#307.dst: 俺は速くて隠密だからな。もう行く、衛兵の目を引きたくない。いいか、W1 だぞ！
Queen's Recruit#307.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#308.src: ...he's energetic, huh. Okay, let's head over to the meeting. I wonder what the others have noticed.
Queen's Recruit#308.dst: …元気だなあ。よし、会議に行こう。みんなは何に気づいたかな。
Queen's Recruit#308.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#309.src: Meet up with the others in room W-{~} at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#310.src: Ah, good, they're here. Come in, come in. Quickly now.
Queen's Recruit#310.dst: ああ、よし、来たな。入って、入って。急いで。
Queen's Recruit#310.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#311.src: Are we the last ones in?
Queen's Recruit#311.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#312.src: That y'are. Now, Picard, mind tellin' me what was on your damned mind when you commandeered my room without sayin' a word ?!
Queen's Recruit#312.dst: その通り。さて Picard、一言もなく俺の部屋を乗っ取ったとき、いったい何を考えてたのか聞かせてもらおうか？！
Queen's Recruit#312.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#313.src: Ah, eheh, well I suppose it, er, may have slipped the mind... not important! We're under a time constraint!
Queen's Recruit#313.dst: ああ、えへへ、まあ、その、うっかり忘れていたかもしれん… 大したことではない！時間がないのだ！
Queen's Recruit#313.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#314.src: We've made it this far, but we'll need to plan our next steps. Firstly, however let us start with what information we have gleaned thus far.
Queen's Recruit#314.dst: ここまでは来たが、次の手を考えねば。だがまずは… これまでに得た情報から始めよう。
Queen's Recruit#314.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#315.src: Well, the crown certainly has money to spare! What we've seen thus far seems to rival even the richest of nobility I had the pleasure of working with in {p}.
Queen's Recruit#315.dst: まあ、王家に金が有り余っているのは確かだ！これまで見たものは、{p} で私が関わった最も裕福な貴族にすら匹敵する。
Queen's Recruit#315.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#316.src: And the architectural style... it's unique. I haven't seen anything like it before. I suppose it would make sense, if the province has been closed off so long...
Queen's Recruit#316.dst: それに建築様式… 独特ね。こんなものは見たことがない。長い間閉ざされていた地方なら、当然かもしれないけど…
Queen's Recruit#316.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#317.src: Eh, enough of the unimportant details any of the rest o' you feelin' strange about the tournament? Seems an odd thing to invite us folks back for.
Queen's Recruit#317.dst: おい、どうでもいい話はそのへんにしろ… トーナメントを妙だと思ってる奴は他にいないか？俺たちを呼び戻す理由にしちゃ変だ。
Queen's Recruit#317.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#318.src: I was thinking the same thing. And they're willing to pay all of us for participating, no matter how we do... I don't get why.
Queen's Recruit#318.dst: 僕も同じことを考えてた。しかも成績に関係なく全員に報酬を払うなんて… 理由がわからない。
Queen's Recruit#318.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#319.src: Hm, well, in truth I am not overly concerned about it
Queen's Recruit#319.dst: ふむ、まあ、正直に言うと私はそれほど気にしていない
Queen's Recruit#319.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#320.src: Yes, actually, Picard, what was that back there in the dining hall? You're going to draw attention to yourself by opting out of it?
Queen's Recruit#320.dst: そうだ、Picard、食堂でのあれは何だったんだ？辞退なんかしたら、かえって目立つだろう？
Queen's Recruit#320.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#321.src: Oh, what use is there in placing me in such a combat scenario?! I'll be far more useful outside of that structure, free to look around the palace.
Queen's Recruit#321.dst: おや、私を戦いの場に放り込んで何の役に立つ？！枠の外にいたほうがずっと有用だ、宮殿を自由に見て回れるからな。
Queen's Recruit#321.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#322.src: And besides, they have me giving them a summary of my research notes, so it's not as though I'm free of it entirely, not to mention
Queen's Recruit#322.dst: それに、研究メモの要約を提出させられているのだから、完全に自由というわけでもない、それに
Queen's Recruit#322.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#323.src: Alright, settle down y'all! Limited time, remember? We've gone off track. They're rich, fancy, and want us fightin' for some reason. What else?
Queen's Recruit#323.dst: はいはい、みんな落ち着いて！時間がないんでしょ？話がそれてる。金持ちで、派手で、なぜかあたしたちを戦わせたい。他には？
Queen's Recruit#323.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#324.src: ...as I was saying before I was rudely interrupted- I don't believe there is much to be gleaned from the tournament just yet. It's a puzzle piece we'll have to connect later.
Queen's Recruit#324.dst: …無礼にも遮られる前に言いかけたように… トーナメントからはまだ大した情報は得られないと思う。後でつなげるパズルの一片だ。
Queen's Recruit#324.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#325.src: Do we have anything on the Queen and her Sovereigns? It's an interesting governmental structure, but I suppose having a more direct line to the Queen has value for the districts.
Queen's Recruit#325.dst: 女王と君主たちについて何かわかった？興味深い統治体制ね。でも地区にとっては、女王に直接話が通じるのは価値があるんでしょう。
Queen's Recruit#325.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#326.src: Well, they're obviously putting on an act. They're definitely hiding something from us, and I don't think any of them are as happy to see us as they say they are.
Queen's Recruit#326.dst: まあ、明らかに芝居だな。何か隠してるのは間違いないし、口で言うほど俺たちに会えて喜んでる奴なんて一人もいないと思う。
Queen's Recruit#326.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#327.src: Yes, indeed... we were sent to Wynn as exiles, not as honored soldiers. So why are they pretending otherwise? They called us back here.
Queen's Recruit#327.dst: 確かに… 我々は名誉ある兵士ではなく、追放者として Wynn へ送られた。なのになぜそうでないふりを？呼び戻したのは彼らだ。
Queen's Recruit#327.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#328.src: Ah! Perhaps they're unaware that we've cracked that memory spell? For all they know, we still believe their lies.
Queen's Recruit#328.dst: おお！記憶の呪文を破ったことを知らないのかもしれん！彼らからすれば、我々はまだ嘘を信じているのだ。
Queen's Recruit#328.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#329.src: It'd explain some things, for certain...
Queen's Recruit#329.dst: 確かにそれで説明がつくね…
Queen's Recruit#329.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#330.src: So am I the only one confused by the amount of guards around?
Queen's Recruit#330.dst: で、衛兵の数に戸惑ってるのは俺だけか？
Queen's Recruit#330.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#331.src: You'd think that nine strangers entering the royal palace would be placed under more watchful eyes.
Queen's Recruit#331.dst: 見知らぬ九人が王宮に入ったら、もっと厳しく見張られると思うだろ。
Queen's Recruit#331.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#332.src: Now that you mention it... the only guards I saw on the way to our rooms were by the courtyard exit. There aren't any outside our rooms.
Queen's Recruit#332.dst: 言われてみれば… 部屋に行くまでに見た衛兵は中庭の出口のところだけだった。部屋の外には誰もいない。
Queen's Recruit#332.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#333.src: ...so we don't need to do the whole stealthy thing?
Queen's Recruit#333.dst: …じゃあこそこそする必要なかったのか？
Queen's Recruit#333.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#334.dst: あたしは楽しかったよ！
Queen's Recruit#334.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#335.src: Seems they want us t' feel safe and trusted. They've got to know we'll be talkin' about everything we see, so why not leave a good impression, eh?
Queen's Recruit#335.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#336.src: Besides, they've got those two Sovereigns lookin' over us. Pretty strong, aren't they? Figure that's enough incentive not to cause trouble.
Queen's Recruit#336.dst: それに、あの君主二人が俺たちを見張ってる。かなり強いだろう？騒ぎを起こさない理由には十分だ。
Queen's Recruit#336.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#337.src: Speakin' of the Sovereigns... and the guards by extension anyone else adept at readin' mana? It hardly feels like there's any of it in use at all!
Queen's Recruit#337.dst: 君主といえば… ついでに衛兵も… 誰かマナを読める人いる？ほとんど魔法が使われてない気がするんだ！
Queen's Recruit#337.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#338.src: I was going to bring that up. I haven't seen any mages at all. The closest I've seen is the higher ranked soldiers wielding magical weapons.
Queen's Recruit#338.dst: それを言おうと思ってた。魔術師を一人も見ていないの。せいぜい上位の兵士が魔法の武器を持っているくらい。
Queen's Recruit#338.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#339.src: I'm not as good with reading mana, but... there's something wrong with the Sovereigns. They've got an incredibly powerful aura surrounding them. It feels... unnatural.
Queen's Recruit#339.dst: 僕はマナを読むのは得意じゃないけど… 君主たちは何かおかしい。ものすごく強いオーラをまとってる。なんだか… 不自然なんだ。
Queen's Recruit#339.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#340.src: Yes, you're right. They, and the Queen, are the only ones I've seen here who possess innate magical abilities. If anything, all three of them seem closely linked in terms of energy...
Queen's Recruit#340.dst: ええ、その通り。生まれつきの魔力を持っているのは、ここでは彼らと女王だけ。むしろ三人ともエネルギーの面で密接につながっているみたい…
Queen's Recruit#340.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#341.src: As interesting as that is, it doesn't leave much for the rest of us to go off of. Doctor, you're the one who organized us here. What are our plans?
Queen's Recruit#341.dst: 興味深いが、それだけでは我々には手がかりが少ない。博士、我々を集めたのはあなただ。計画は？
Queen's Recruit#341.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#342.src: Yes, that I am... well, it seems our most promising lead is the Sovereigns. We'll want to focus on them though, do not neglect general information. We still want to know as much about Fruma as possible.
Queen's Recruit#342.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#343.src: We've been running long enough, let's call it a day. Everyone, get some rest, we must be at our best performance tomorrow.
Queen's Recruit#343.dst: もう十分長引いた、今日はここまでにしよう。皆、休んでくれ、明日は最高の状態でいなければ。
Queen's Recruit#343.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#344.src: Let us gather here again tomorrow evening for another meeting. Goodnight, everyone.
Queen's Recruit#344.dst: 明日の夕方、またここに集まって会議をしよう。おやすみ、諸君。
Queen's Recruit#344.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#345.src: Make your way back to W-{~} and sleep.
Queen's Recruit#345.dst: W-{~} 号室に戻って眠る。

Queen's Recruit#346.src: Those Sovereigns... they do concern me. If Fruma's leadership holds this much power, then...
Queen's Recruit#346.dst: あの君主たち… 気がかりだ。Fruma の指導者がこれほどの力を持つなら…
Queen's Recruit#346.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#347.src: Hm. Perhaps our King is right not to get on their bad side.
Queen's Recruit#347.dst: ふむ。我らが王が彼らの機嫌を損ねまいとするのも正しいのかもしれん。
Queen's Recruit#347.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#348.src: Ah, great, now all o' you are lingerin'. Get out of my room! Not gonna get a lick o' sleep till you're gone...
Queen's Recruit#348.dst: ああ、結構なこった、今度は全員居座りか。俺の部屋から出てけ！お前らがいなくならなきゃ一睡もできん…
Queen's Recruit#348.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#349.src: ...damned Doctor should'a just used his own room!!
Queen's Recruit#349.dst: …あの博士め、自分の部屋を使えばよかったんだ！！
Queen's Recruit#349.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#350.src: ...sigh. What am I doing here? I should have stayed back in {p}.
Queen's Recruit#350.dst: …はあ。俺は何をしてるんだ？{p} に残るべきだった。
Queen's Recruit#350.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#351.src: I just hope nobody here knew me before. I'm not sure I could handle that.
Queen's Recruit#351.dst: ここに昔の俺を知ってる人がいないといいが。耐えられる自信がない。
Queen's Recruit#351.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#352.src: Hm... a shame I could not fight in the tournament. A monetary reward would be appreciated, given my dwindling research funds...
Queen's Recruit#352.dst: ふむ… トーナメントに出られなかったのは残念だ。研究資金が減る一方だから、賞金はありがたかったのだが…
Queen's Recruit#352.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#353.src: But, alas, I am no fighter. Perhaps the King would be willing to fund my future research...
Queen's Recruit#353.dst: だが、ああ、私は戦士ではない。王が今後の研究に資金を出してくれるかもしれんな…
Queen's Recruit#353.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#354.src: Gosh, I hope my match tomorrow goes well. I'm a bit nervous... never really dueled anyone before!
Queen's Recruit#354.dst: ああ、明日の試合うまくいくといいな。ちょっと緊張する… 決闘なんてしたことないんだ！
Queen's Recruit#354.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#356.src: What? It's been a long day.
Queen's Recruit#356.dst: 何だよ？長い一日だったんだ。
Queen's Recruit#356.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#357.src: That magic... why does it feel familiar? I can't pinpoint what it is, but...
Queen's Recruit#357.dst: あの魔力… なぜ見覚えがあるの？何なのかはっきりしないけど…
Queen's Recruit#357.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#358.src: Let's just go get some sleep.
Queen's Recruit#358.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#359.src: Goodnight, {u}. I hope you'll sleep better than I will.
Queen's Recruit#359.dst: おやすみ、{u}。僕よりよく眠れるといいね。
Queen's Recruit#359.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#361.src: {u}! We're going to miss the first round if you sleep any longer!
Queen's Recruit#361.dst: {u}！これ以上寝てたら一回戦に遅れるよ！
Queen's Recruit#361.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#364.src: Well, I feel your pain. I don't think I got more than an hour or two. I kept... I should have expected it'd be worse here. I just hoped... well, it is what it is.
Queen's Recruit#364.dst: そうか、わかるよ。僕も一、二時間しか眠れなかった。ずっと… ここではもっとひどくなるって予想すべきだった。ただ願ってたんだ… まあ、仕方ない。
Queen's Recruit#364.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#365.src: But anyway, it's good you're up. A soldier just came by to tell us to head over to the tournament arena.
Queen's Recruit#365.dst: とにかく、起きてくれてよかった。さっき兵士が来て、トーナメント会場へ行くよう言われたんだ。
Queen's Recruit#365.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#366.src: You... no, they just... knocked and slid the notice under the door.
Queen's Recruit#366.dst: 君… いや、ただ… ノックしてドアの下から通知を差し込んでいったんだ。
Queen's Recruit#366.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#367.src: Was someone in our room during the night...?
Queen's Recruit#367.dst: 夜の間に誰か部屋に入ったのかな…？
Queen's Recruit#367.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#368.src: I don't... like... that. Not at all.
Queen's Recruit#368.dst: それは… 嫌だな… 本当に。
Queen's Recruit#368.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#369.src: Still. We need to head over to the arena. Apparently, it's in the northern part of the palace.
Queen's Recruit#369.dst: とにかく。闘技場に行かないと。宮殿の北側にあるらしい。
Queen's Recruit#369.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#370.src: Find the location of the tournament in the northern side of the palace at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#370.dst: 宮殿北側の [-{~}, {~}, {~}] でトーナメント会場を探す。

Queen's Recruit#371.src: Well, well. Looks like we'll finally get to test which o' us is stronger, eh, captain?
Queen's Recruit#371.dst: さてさて。ようやくどっちが強いか試せるな、隊長？
Queen's Recruit#371.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#372.src: Oh, finally? I wasn't aware there was even a question! Lieutenant, do you truly think you stand a chance against me?
Queen's Recruit#372.dst: おや、ようやく？議論の余地があるとは知らなかった！中尉、本気で私に勝てると思っているのか？
Queen's Recruit#372.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#373.src: Ah, enough o' your posturin', Kymer! You might be all up n' fancy these days, but I still remember when you were but a rookie, all afraid of a lil' old zombie!
Queen's Recruit#373.dst: ああ、気取るのはよせ、Kymer！今は立派になったもんだが、お前がちっぽけな老いぼれゾンビにびびってた新米の頃を覚えてるぞ！
Queen's Recruit#373.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#374.src: Ha! Ah, good times. Good times. You'll get your recognition too one of these days, you know. Maybe you'll even surpass my rank someday!
Queen's Recruit#374.dst: はっ！ああ、懐かしい。懐かしいな。君もいつか認められる日が来るさ。いずれ私の階級を超えるかもしれんぞ！
Queen's Recruit#374.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#375.src: Eh, you say that every time. Besides, the lower ranks suit me well. Don't think I'd do well with all that "responsibility" the big wigs put on your shoulders.
Queen's Recruit#375.dst: へっ、毎回そう言うな。それに下の階級のほうが性に合ってる。お偉いさんが背負わせる「責任」なんてのは向いてない。
Queen's Recruit#375.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#376.src: ...all that bein' said, you're still goin' down when it's our go! I got some new tricks since the last time we fought, so don't get too cocky!
Queen's Recruit#376.dst: …とはいえ、俺たちの番になったらお前は負けだ！前回やり合ってから新しい技を覚えたんだ、調子に乗るなよ！
Queen's Recruit#376.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#377.src: Ha! Then I look forward to seeing them.
Queen's Recruit#377.dst: はっ！楽しみにしていよう。
Queen's Recruit#377.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#378.src: If you're looking for the tournament arena, go down this corridor then turn to the left.
Queen's Recruit#378.dst: トーナメント会場をお探しなら、この廊下を進んで左に曲がってください。
Queen's Recruit#378.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#379.src: The tournament arena is further down the corridor.
Queen's Recruit#379.dst: トーナメント会場はこの廊下の先です。
Queen's Recruit#379.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#380.src: This area is unfortunately not accessible at this moment.
Queen's Recruit#380.dst: 申し訳ありませんが、この区域は現在立ち入りできません。
Queen's Recruit#380.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#381.src: This is Her Majesty's own personal quarter.
Queen's Recruit#381.dst: ここは女王陛下の私室です。
Queen's Recruit#381.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#382.src: I'm afraid I can't let you in just yet. Not until
Queen's Recruit#382.dst: 残念ですが、まだお通しできません。それまでは
Queen's Recruit#382.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#383.src: Yes, yes, my research notes, I am aware. It has been sorted already. May I visit the library now?
Queen's Recruit#383.dst: はいはい、研究メモだろう、わかっている。もう済ませた。図書館へ行ってもいいかね？
Queen's Recruit#383.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#384.src: Don't interrupt me. You can't enter until this round of tournament matches concludes. Her Majesty's orders.
Queen's Recruit#384.dst: 遮らないでください。今回の試合が終わるまで入れません。女王陛下のご命令です。
Queen's Recruit#384.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#385.src: Pah. Fine! Fine, yes, I'll wait. Good grief.
Queen's Recruit#385.dst: ふん。わかった！わかったとも、待つさ。やれやれ。
Queen's Recruit#385.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#386.src: You'd think I would have some level of freedom, but no! What does it matter if I don't want to watch the matches if there's nothing else to do?!
Queen's Recruit#386.dst: 少しは自由があると思うだろう、だがない！他にすることがないのに、試合を見たくないくらい何だというのだ？！
Queen's Recruit#386.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#387.src: Oh, just go and get your match over with. Quit stalling.
Queen's Recruit#387.dst: ああ、さっさと試合を済ませてきたまえ。ぐずぐずするな。
Queen's Recruit#387.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#389.src: Just head down these stairs to find the tournament arena.
Queen's Recruit#389.dst: この階段を下りればトーナメント会場です。
Queen's Recruit#389.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#390.src: The match ups will be announced once everyone is present.
Queen's Recruit#390.dst: 全員そろい次第、組み合わせを発表します。
Queen's Recruit#390.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#391.src: Uh. Sovereign... Majin? Sovereign Majin. We're all here.
Queen's Recruit#391.dst: あー。君主… Majin？君主 Majin。全員そろったぞ。
Queen's Recruit#391.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#392.src: My, it's about time! As guests of the crown, it would do you well to arrive on time for such things, hm? Tardiness is not a good look.
Queen's Recruit#392.dst: おや、ようやくか！王家の客人たる者、こういう場には時間通りに来るべきではないかね？遅刻は見苦しいぞ。
Queen's Recruit#392.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#393.src: Our apologies, Sovereign. It would seem we were not given the time to be here in advance a humble mistake, I'm certain.
Queen's Recruit#393.dst: 申し訳ありません、君主殿。どうやら前もって来る時間を知らされていなかったようで… ささいな手違いでしょう。
Queen's Recruit#393.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#394.src: Ah, the incompetence of our lessers... it never ceases to amaze! Nevertheless, the duty of arriving on schedule remains on your shoulders. Do better next time, would you?
Queen's Recruit#394.dst: ああ、下々の者の無能さ… 本当に驚かされる！それでも、時間通りに来る責任は諸君にある。次はしっかりしてくれたまえ？
Queen's Recruit#394.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#395.src: Now, I am a very busy man, so I will keep this brief. As Her Majesty has already explained, this tournament will consist of multiple duels! You are not required to watch each match.
Queen's Recruit#395.dst: さて、私は非常に忙しい身なので手短に済ませよう。陛下がすでに説明された通り、このトーナメントは複数の決闘で構成される！各試合を観戦する必要はない。
Queen's Recruit#395.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#396.src: The standard rules apply. No killing, no maiming, no attacking anyone outside the arena - though, do try, I'd find much pleasure in watching you fail!
Queen's Recruit#396.dst: 通常のルールが適用される。殺しも、重傷を負わせるのも、場外への攻撃も禁止… まあ、やってみたまえ、失敗するのを見るのは実に愉快だろう！
Queen's Recruit#396.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#397.src: With that settled, are there any questions? I would certainly hope not, I have much to return to once this is
Queen's Recruit#397.dst: では、質問はあるかね？ないことを願うよ、これが終わったら戻らねばならん仕事が山ほど
Queen's Recruit#397.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#398.src: Ah, I do I am not participating in the tournament. I had been told to expect some alternative today.
Queen's Recruit#398.dst: ああ、あります… 私はトーナメントに参加しません。今日は代わりの何かがあると聞いていたのですが。
Queen's Recruit#398.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#399.src: Oh, yes... you. What did you say you were again, a... researcher?
Queen's Recruit#399.dst: ああ、そう… 君か。何と言ったかな、ええと… 研究者？
Queen's Recruit#399.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#400.src: Ahahaha! Oh, and they selected you as one of your province's greatest? Don't make me laugh! Ahahahahaha!
Queen's Recruit#400.dst: あはははは！おや、それで君が地方でも指折りの者に選ばれたと？笑わせないでくれたまえ！あはははははは！
Queen's Recruit#400.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#401.src: Ah, but it's just as well, I suppose. Nine certainly doesn't fit cleanly for such a tournament. Better a researcher than a ninth fighter!
Queen's Recruit#401.dst: ああ、だがそれも好都合か。九人ではトーナメントにきれいに収まらん。九人目の戦士より研究者のほうがましだ！
Queen's Recruit#401.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#402.src: Yes, someone will be with you shortly. Just sit on the sidelines and twiddle your thumbs, or whatever you do you certainly aren't my problem anymore.
Queen's Recruit#402.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#405.src: Excellent! The first match up appears to be... {u} and Mel. Step forward, the two of you.
Queen's Recruit#405.dst: 結構！最初の組み合わせは… {u} と Mel だ。二人とも前へ。
Queen's Recruit#405.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#408.src: Well, hurry up now, get prepared! Choose a corridor each, north or south, and get to fighting already!
Queen's Recruit#408.dst: さあ急いで準備したまえ！北か南の通路をそれぞれ選んで、さっさと戦いたまえ！
Queen's Recruit#408.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#409.src: As for the rest of you... oh, I can't be bothered. Read your matchups on the board yourselves.
Queen's Recruit#409.dst: 他の者は… ああ、面倒だ。組み合わせは掲示板で各自確認したまえ。
Queen's Recruit#409.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#410.src: Uh... alrighty then. I guess I'll choose this one.
Queen's Recruit#410.dst: え… わかったよ。じゃあこっちにする。
Queen's Recruit#410.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#411.src: Begin your fight against Mel in the southern waiting room.
Queen's Recruit#411.dst: 南の控え室で Mel との戦いを始める。

Queen's Recruit#413.src: Just 'cause we've got a mission here, doesn't mean I'll go easy on ya!
Queen's Recruit#413.dst: 任務があるからって、手加減はしないよ！
Queen's Recruit#413.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#414.src: Ready to go?! Let's show them what we're made of!
Queen's Recruit#414.dst: 準備はいい？！あたしたちの実力を見せてやろう！
Queen's Recruit#414.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#415.src: Phew! What a fight! Got my blood rushin'!
Queen's Recruit#415.dst: ふう！すごい戦いだった！血が騒いだよ！
Queen's Recruit#415.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#416.src: What'd you think of my trick? Pretty good, right? Makes me less of a sittin' duck in combat!
Queen's Recruit#416.dst: あたしの技どうだった？なかなかでしょ？これで戦闘中いい的にならずに済むんだ！
Queen's Recruit#416.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#417.src: Ah, I didn't think I was gonna be winnin' anything, really. But it was fun givin' it a shot.
Queen's Recruit#417.dst: まあ、勝てるとは思ってなかったけどね。でも挑戦するのは楽しかった。
Queen's Recruit#417.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#418.src: {u} has bested Mel in the first round, and will progress to the next!
Queen's Recruit#418.dst: {u} が一回戦で Mel に勝利し、次の試合へ進みます！
Queen's Recruit#418.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#420.src: You will be permitted to remain in the palace for the duration of the tournament. You will be paid for your participation at the end of your stay.
Queen's Recruit#420.dst: トーナメントの間は宮殿に滞在していただけます。参加報酬は滞在の最後にお支払いします。
Queen's Recruit#420.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#421.src: I figure that makes sense. I wonder when Lanu's match is...
Queen's Recruit#421.dst: まあ、そうだよね。Lanu の試合はいつかな…
Queen's Recruit#421.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#422.src: {u}, congratulations on your victory. You will be notified when your next match is. In the meantime, feel free to rest.
Queen's Recruit#422.dst: {u}、勝利おめでとうございます。次の試合は追ってお知らせします。それまでご自由にお休みください。
Queen's Recruit#422.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#423.src: Leave the arena waiting room and find Picard at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#423.dst: 闘技場の控え室を出て、[-{~}, {~}, {~}] で Picard を探す。

Queen's Recruit#424.src: It was a good fight! But you'd better win in my honor now, y'hear?
Queen's Recruit#424.dst: いい勝負だった！あたしの分まで勝ってよね、いい？
Queen's Recruit#424.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#425.src: We will announce your next match later. Please feel free to rest or enjoy the palace in the meantime.
Queen's Recruit#425.dst: 次の試合は後ほど発表します。それまでご自由にお休みいただくか、宮殿をお楽しみください。
Queen's Recruit#425.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#426.src: Ah, {u}, I saw the match! Very good technique, better than many soldiers I've seen pass through {p} in my time.
Queen's Recruit#426.dst: おお、{u}、試合を見たぞ！実に見事な技だ、私が {p} で見てきた多くの兵士よりも上だ。
Queen's Recruit#426.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#427.src: I suppose I'm not surprised! When the tournament was announced, you came to mind as a potential winner. You, and one other person, that is.
Queen's Recruit#427.dst: 驚きはしないがね！トーナメントが発表されたとき、優勝候補として君が頭に浮かんだ。君と、もう一人な。
Queen's Recruit#427.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#428.src: Hm... maybe I could start taking bets on who will win... ah, no, no, I'm far too busy. Stay focused, Picard.
Queen's Recruit#428.dst: ふむ… 誰が勝つか賭けを始めるのも… いや、いかんいかん、忙しすぎる。集中しろ、Picard。
Queen's Recruit#428.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#429.src: Hm? Oh dear, I'd forgotten you were here! Yes, I was going to do something...
Queen's Recruit#429.dst: ん？おや、君がいるのを忘れていた！そうだ、何かしようとしていたんだ…
Queen's Recruit#429.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#430.src: Oh! The library! Can you believe it, that damnable guard finally stepped away! It's ridiculous, really who even cares to guard a library of all things?!
Queen's Recruit#430.dst: おお！図書館だ！信じられるか、あの忌々しい衛兵がついに離れたのだ！馬鹿げている… 図書館なんぞ誰が守りたがる？！
Queen's Recruit#430.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#431.src: But. But but but. The way is open, and although the tournament round is still ongoing, I'd like to take the opportunity while I can!
Queen's Recruit#431.dst: だが。だがだがだが。道は開いた、まだ試合は続いているが、この機会を逃したくない！
Queen's Recruit#431.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#432.src: Care to join me? I'm sure there's something you'll find interesting in there. What sorts of knowledge have the Frumans kept hidden in these walls...
Queen's Recruit#432.dst: 一緒に来るかね？君が興味を持つものもきっとある。Fruma の者がこの壁の中にどんな知識を隠してきたのか…
Queen's Recruit#432.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#433.src: Well, are you coming? Come now, quickly, before the guard returns!
Queen's Recruit#433.dst: さあ、来るのか？ほら、急いで、衛兵が戻る前に！
Queen's Recruit#433.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#434.dst: Picard について図書館に入る。

Queen's Recruit#435.src: Goodness, where to even begin? There's so much here...
Queen's Recruit#435.dst: やれやれ、どこから手をつけたものか？ここには山ほどある…
Queen's Recruit#435.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#436.src: I hereby introduce to you The Evermoving Zephyr, the ruler of the {p}, the latest in the line of one of Fruma's great noble houses! His lordship, Sovereign Zhiraok Nasin!
Queen's Recruit#436.dst: ここにご紹介いたします、永遠に吹く風、{p} の統治者、Fruma の名家の当代当主！閣下、君主 Zhiraok Nasin！

Queen's Recruit#437.src: ...and that we're rifling through the Cursed instead of our own citizens is an incalculable risk!
Queen's Recruit#437.dst: …しかも自国民ではなく呪われし者を漁るなど、計り知れない危険だ！

Queen's Recruit#438.src: What was that?! Quickly, quickly now, follow me!
Queen's Recruit#438.dst: 今のは何だ？！急げ、急いで、ついて来い！
Queen's Recruit#438.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#439.src: Do you have eyes on the speaker? Who is it?
Queen's Recruit#439.dst: 話している者が見えるか？誰だ？
Queen's Recruit#439.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#440.src: I can't find her angle for this hunt.
Queen's Recruit#440.dst: 彼女の狩りの角度が読めん。
Queen's Recruit#440.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#441.src: Ah, it's like I'm talking with her again! It's so nostalgic to speak with a clueless Nasin trying their hardest, in spite of their incompe
Queen's Recruit#441.dst: ああ、まるで彼女とまた話しているようだ！何も知らない Nasin が必死になるのは実に懐かしい、その無能さにもかかわら
Queen's Recruit#441.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#442.src: I'M SORRY, YOU IGNORANT INTEGRAND? You really think now is the time for- Rrgh... Why. Do I even bother.
Queen's Recruit#442.dst: 何だと、この無知な被積分関数め？今がそんな時だと本気で… ぐぬ… なぜ。私はいちいち相手をするんだ。
Queen's Recruit#442.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#443.src: Why, indeed! It truly is a bad habit. Something to work on while your seniors do the important work, hm?
Queen's Recruit#443.dst: まったくだ！実に悪い癖だよ。先輩方が大事な仕事をしている間に直しておきたまえ？
Queen's Recruit#443.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#444.src: Speaking of, I must put forth that I do find this all a bit strange. We most certainly aren't lacking in strength here, so why bother with the exiles?
Queen's Recruit#444.dst: ところで、正直言ってこの件は少し妙だと思うのだがね。ここは力に困っていないのに、なぜわざわざ追放者を？
Queen's Recruit#444.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#445.src: ...sigh... The risk factor is much greater than I'd bet on. She has to know more than we do, so maybe we'll get a summation later.
Queen's Recruit#445.dst: …はあ… リスク要因は私の見積もりよりずっと大きい。彼女は我々より多くを知っているはずだ、後でその総和を聞けるかもしれん。
Queen's Recruit#445.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#447.src: Ah, there she is. Fashionably late as always!
Queen's Recruit#447.dst: ああ、来たか。相変わらずおしゃれな遅刻だね！
Queen's Recruit#447.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#448.src: Hm. If anything, I was early.
Queen's Recruit#448.dst: ふん。むしろ早いくらい。

Queen's Recruit#449.src: I'd say your timing was golden- if you're here for that summation I mentioned, and this isn't anything else.
Queen's Recruit#449.dst: タイミングは黄金比だと言いたいところだ… 私の言った総和のために来たのならな、他の用でなければ。
Queen's Recruit#449.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#450.src: It's the former. But first, have you been watching the battles? Do any of the contestants stick out to you?
Queen's Recruit#450.dst: 前者よ。でもその前に、試合は見ていた？目立つ参加者はいた？

Queen's Recruit#451.src: Stick out? Hardly. Thus far, I have been thoroughly unimpressed.
Queen's Recruit#451.dst: 目立つ？まさか。今のところ、まったく感心しないね。
Queen's Recruit#451.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#452.src: Naturally you would be. I've seen some generally promising things, but I need to know the expected solution to narrow the pool
Queen's Recruit#452.dst: お前ならそうだろう。私は有望そうなのをいくつか見たが、候補を絞るには期待される解を知る必要が
Queen's Recruit#452.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#453.src: Ah, ah! Settle down, Nasin, your betters are speaking. Calculate yourself out of dead last, first.
Queen's Recruit#453.dst: おっと、おっと！落ち着きたまえ Nasin、目上が話しているのだ。まずは計算で最下位から抜け出すことだね。
Queen's Recruit#453.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#454.src: Later, then. We have problems. The contestants have been sneaking around. And the doctor has been taking meticulous notes.
Queen's Recruit#454.dst: それは後で。問題があるの。参加者たちがこそこそ嗅ぎ回ってる。それに博士が綿密なメモを取っているわ。

Queen's Recruit#455.src: ...looks like you letting him sit out the problem was a miscalculation, huh?
Queen's Recruit#455.dst: …あいつを問題から外したのは計算違いだったようだな？
Queen's Recruit#455.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#456.src: For once, we appear to be in agreement. What a pity, what a hassle... it hardly seems worth the effort to me.
Queen's Recruit#456.dst: 珍しく意見が合ったね。なんとも残念、なんとも面倒… 私にはその労力に見合うとは思えんがね。
Queen's Recruit#456.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#457.src: It will be. But I've spent too much time here already. You'll have to wait for answers.
Queen's Recruit#457.dst: 見合うわ。でもここに長居しすぎた。答えはもう少し待って。

Queen's Recruit#458.src: Of course. How much more irrational can we get, I wonder.
Queen's Recruit#458.dst: もちろん。どこまで不合理になれるのやら。
Queen's Recruit#458.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#459.src: If you'd like something to look out for, one of the more promising candidates is set to have a match soon. Go watch it.
Queen's Recruit#459.dst: 注目したいなら、有望な候補の一人がまもなく試合をするわ。見に行きなさい。

Queen's Recruit#460.src: A joy as always. Well, you heard her, Nasin! Chop chop, off to the stands we go!
Queen's Recruit#460.dst: 相変わらず楽しいね。さあ、聞いただろう Nasin！さっさと観覧席へ行こうじゃないか！
Queen's Recruit#460.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#461.src: ...so not even the Sovereigns know what's happening. Fascinating. Very fascinating.
Queen's Recruit#461.dst: …君主たちですら何が起きているか知らないのか。興味深い。実に興味深い。
Queen's Recruit#461.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#462.src: And there was a third! Who were they? Another Sovereign...? Damn it, damn it all, how did I not notice?
Queen's Recruit#462.dst: しかも三人目がいた！誰だったのだ？別の君主…？くそ、くそっ、なぜ気づかなかった？
Queen's Recruit#462.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#463.src: Well, they appear to be onto us. No matter. We'll need to be more careful.
Queen's Recruit#463.dst: どうやら我々は目をつけられたらしい。構わん。もっと慎重にならねば。
Queen's Recruit#463.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#464.src: You'd best get back to the arena. In the meantime, I'll keep searching here... there must be something useful!
Queen's Recruit#464.dst: 君は闘技場に戻ったほうがいい。その間、私はここを探し続ける… 何か役立つものがあるはずだ！
Queen's Recruit#464.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#466.src: ...hm? Oh, yes, fine, I'll tell the rest about what we heard. After I'm done here, of course.
Queen's Recruit#466.dst: …ん？ああ、わかった、聞いたことは他の者に伝える。ここが終わってから、もちろんな。
Queen's Recruit#466.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#467.src: The first round of the tournament has concluded!
Queen's Recruit#467.dst: トーナメントの一回戦が終了しました！
Queen's Recruit#467.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#468.src: The names that will proceed to the next round... {u}! Tasim! Reynauld! Kymer!
Queen's Recruit#468.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#469.src: {u}, your match will begin shortly. Your opponent is already in the waiting room.
Queen's Recruit#469.dst: {u}、まもなく試合が始まります。対戦相手はすでに控え室にいます。
Queen's Recruit#469.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#470.src: Make your way to the arena.
Queen's Recruit#470.dst: 闘技場へお進みください。
Queen's Recruit#470.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#471.src: Begin your next duel in the arena down the stairs.
Queen's Recruit#471.dst: 階段下の闘技場で次の決闘を始める。

Queen's Recruit#472.src: Please make your way to the arena by following the stairs down.
Queen's Recruit#472.dst: 階段を下りて闘技場へお進みください。
Queen's Recruit#472.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#473.src: Please go to the waiting room and prepare for the battle.
Queen's Recruit#473.dst: 控え室へ行き、戦いの準備をしてください。
Queen's Recruit#473.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#475.src: Well, you'll likely prove more of a challenge than Linton, that's for sure.
Queen's Recruit#475.dst: まあ、Linton よりは手ごたえがありそうだ、それは確かだ。
Queen's Recruit#475.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#476.src: You've come a long way since {p}, haven't you? Well, so have I! Let's battle.
Queen's Recruit#476.dst: {p} の頃からずいぶん成長したんじゃないか？まあ、俺もだ！戦おう。
Queen's Recruit#476.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#477.src: The battle is decided! {u} has come out victorious.
Queen's Recruit#477.dst: 勝負あり！{u} の勝利です。
Queen's Recruit#477.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#478.src: Ah... good fighting, {u}. I even used some of my most powerful arrows.
Queen's Recruit#478.dst: ああ… いい戦いだった、{u}。最強の矢まで使ったのにな。
Queen's Recruit#478.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#480.src: I know, I know. You were a worthy opponent, {u}. Now, you'll be winning this whole thing, yes?
Queen's Recruit#480.dst: わかってる、わかってる。手ごわい相手だったよ、{u}。このまま全部勝つんだろう？
Queen's Recruit#480.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#481.src: {u}, congratulations on reaching the finals. All other opponents have been defeated, except for you and your fellow finalist.
Queen's Recruit#481.dst: {u}、決勝進出おめでとうございます。あなたともう一人の決勝進出者を除き、全員が敗れました。
Queen's Recruit#481.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#482.src: Hmph. That will be announced shortly. Please make your way to the courtyard and await further instructions.
Queen's Recruit#482.dst: ふん。それはまもなく発表されます。中庭へ行き、次の指示をお待ちください。
Queen's Recruit#482.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#483.src: Return to the courtyard at [-{~}, {~}, {~}] and find other contestants.
Queen's Recruit#483.dst: [-{~}, {~}, {~}] の中庭に戻り、他の参加者を探す。

Queen's Recruit#484.src: I did well enough, I suppose. I'll be glad for this to all be over, anyway.
Queen's Recruit#484.dst: まあ、よくやったほうだろう。とにかく全部終わってくれたらありがたい。
Queen's Recruit#484.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#485.src: Please make your way to the courtyard and await further instructions.
Queen's Recruit#485.dst: 中庭へ行き、次の指示をお待ちください。
Queen's Recruit#485.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#486.src: {u}, you return! Well, how did your match go?
Queen's Recruit#486.dst: {u}、戻ったか！で、試合はどうだった？
Queen's Recruit#486.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#487.src: You? I suppose that would make sense. No offense intended, Reynauld, but I would have bet on {u} if I had the chance.
Queen's Recruit#487.dst: 君が？まあ納得だ。悪気はないがね Reynauld、賭けられるなら私は {u} に賭けていた。
Queen's Recruit#487.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#488.src: Ha. For me, certainly! It felt like I could barely make a dent in your stamina.
Queen's Recruit#488.dst: はっ。俺にとっては確かに手ごわかった！体力を削れた気がまるでしなかった。
Queen's Recruit#488.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#489.src: Yes, yes, congratulations are in order, and all that we have problems.
Queen's Recruit#489.dst: はいはい、おめでとう、何やかんや… 問題が起きた。
Queen's Recruit#489.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#490.src: It was problem enough that he was called here in the first place... to think, he could
Queen's Recruit#490.dst: そもそも彼がここに呼ばれたこと自体が問題だった… まさか、彼が
Queen's Recruit#490.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#491.src: That is enough about the tournament. I don't want to hear about it anymore. The doctor is right.
Queen's Recruit#491.dst: トーナメントの話はもう十分。これ以上聞きたくないわ。博士の言う通りよ。
Queen's Recruit#491.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#492.src: Yes, well, it's not your honour on the line... but fine, I admit, this third Sovereign is... troubling.
Queen's Recruit#492.dst: ああ、まあ、懸かっているのは君の名誉ではないからな… だがいい、認めよう、三人目の君主は… 厄介だ。
Queen's Recruit#492.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#493.src: Hm. Have we been able to find the information we needed?
Queen's Recruit#493.dst: ふむ。必要な情報は見つかったのか？
Queen's Recruit#493.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#494.src: No! And that is precisely our problem we are missing something, and we are running out of time! One final match, and then it's done.
Queen's Recruit#494.dst: いいや！そしてそれこそが問題なのだ… 何かを見落としていて、しかも時間がない！決勝戦が終われば、それで終わりだ。
Queen's Recruit#494.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#495.src: ...truthfully, I'm surprised you were on my side for that match.
Queen's Recruit#495.dst: …正直、あの試合で君が僕の味方だったのは意外だったよ。
Queen's Recruit#495.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#496.src: Ah, well, someone had t' take him down a peg! Guess that someone was you.
Queen's Recruit#496.dst: ああ、まあ、誰かがあいつの鼻をへし折らなきゃな！その誰かがお前だったってわけだ。
Queen's Recruit#496.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#497.src: Oh, give me a break, lieutenant. Him? Of all people to
Queen's Recruit#497.dst: おいおい、勘弁してくれ、中尉。彼が？よりによって
Queen's Recruit#497.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#498.src: Hey, everyone's here! Is... this where they wanted everyone to gather up?
Queen's Recruit#498.dst: やあ、みんないる！ここに… 全員集まれってことなのかな？
Queen's Recruit#498.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#499.src: Seems that way. You won your match?
Queen's Recruit#499.dst: そうみたい。試合に勝ったの？
Queen's Recruit#499.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#500.src: I did. It seems I'm a finalist now. So, who's the other one?
Queen's Recruit#500.dst: うん。決勝進出だって。で、もう一人は誰？
Queen's Recruit#500.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#501.src: Oh! Well, congratulations! Though, I guess we'll be facing each other soon.
Queen's Recruit#501.dst: おお！じゃあ、おめでとう！でも、もうすぐ対戦することになるね。
Queen's Recruit#501.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#502.src: Good grief... yes, the tournament has happened, congratulations to the finalists, whatever where are Mel and Linton? We need to discuss what's next, before
Queen's Recruit#502.dst: やれやれ… ああ、トーナメントは終わった、決勝進出者おめでとう、何でもいい… Mel と Linton はどこだ？次のことを話し合わねば、その前に
Queen's Recruit#502.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#503.src: ...and so, what, I'm not allowed to take a nap now? I wasn't even fighting!! Mel, back me up, come on!
Queen's Recruit#503.dst: …で、何だよ、昼寝もしちゃいけないのか？俺は戦ってすらいないんだぞ！！Mel、味方してくれよ、なあ！
Queen's Recruit#503.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#504.src: He's right, this hardly seems fair! We were told we could stay in our rooms until the tournament had concluded, so why the change?!
Queen's Recruit#504.dst: その通りだよ、こんなの不公平だ！トーナメントが終わるまで部屋にいていいって言われたのに、なんで変わったのさ？！
Queen's Recruit#504.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#506.src: Any competitors who have lost in the tournament are to be escorted out of Fruma, effective immediately.
Queen's Recruit#506.dst: トーナメントで敗れた参加者は、ただちに Fruma から護送退去させる。
Queen's Recruit#506.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#507.src: what is the meaning of this?!
Queen's Recruit#507.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#508.src: SILENCE! These are new orders from Her Majesty.
Queen's Recruit#508.dst: 静粛に！女王陛下からの新たなご命令だ。
Queen's Recruit#508.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#509.src: Only {u} and Tasim are permitted to remain in the palace. Any defiance will be seen as an official threat against Fruma from the Wynn province.
Queen's Recruit#509.dst: 宮殿に残ることを許されるのは {u} と Tasim のみ。反抗すれば、Wynn 地方から Fruma への正式な脅威とみなす。
Queen's Recruit#509.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#510.src: Comply, and no one will be hurt. You will still receive your promised reward for participation.
Queen's Recruit#510.dst: 従えば誰も傷つかない。約束された参加報酬は引き続き受け取れる。
Queen's Recruit#510.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#512.src: Enough, Kymer. What's done is done. We have no choice.
Queen's Recruit#512.dst: よせ、Kymer。済んだことだ。選択の余地はない。
Queen's Recruit#512.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#514.src: You two. Stay safe, and be on guard. I'll report back to the King with this news. If you're not released safely...
Queen's Recruit#514.dst: 君たち二人。気をつけて、警戒を怠るな。この知らせは王に報告する。君たちが無事に解放されなければ…
Queen's Recruit#514.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#515.src: ...{u}. Tasim. I've gotten what I came here for originally, but... I don't know what they're planning. You'll have to handle it on your own.
Queen's Recruit#515.dst: …{u}。Tasim。もともとの目的は果たしたが… 彼らが何を企んでいるかはわからん。あとは君たちだけで対処してくれ。
Queen's Recruit#515.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#517.src: Remaining finalists, you are expected in the dining hall shortly. Attend your last meal before the finals.
Queen's Recruit#517.dst: 残る決勝進出者は、まもなく食堂へ来るように。決勝前の最後の食事に出席せよ。
Queen's Recruit#517.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#519.src: What was that? What just happened?
Queen's Recruit#519.dst: 今のは何？何が起きたの？
Queen's Recruit#519.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#520.src: They've changed the rules on us, and now... ugh, we have no choice... We need to see it through.
Queen's Recruit#520.dst: 規則を勝手に変えられて、今は… うう、選択肢がない… 最後までやり抜くしかない。
Queen's Recruit#520.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#521.src: Well... come on. Let's attend our final dinner here.
Queen's Recruit#521.dst: さて… 行こう。ここでの最後の夕食に出よう。
Queen's Recruit#521.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#522.dst: [-{~}, {~}, {~}] で王家の晩餐に出席する。

Queen's Recruit#523.src: What are we supposed to do...?
Queen's Recruit#523.dst: 僕たち、どうすればいいんだ…？
Queen's Recruit#523.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#524.src: They'll let us out. They have to. It'd be a diplomatic disaster if they didn't.
Queen's Recruit#524.dst: 僕たちは出してもらえる。そうでなきゃ。出さなかったら外交上の大惨事だ。
Queen's Recruit#524.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#525.dst: 決勝進出者の皆さん。ようこそ。
Queen's Recruit#525.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#526.src: If you were not already aware, your fellow soldiers have been returned to Wynn. Safely.
Queen's Recruit#526.dst: まだご存じないなら、お仲間は Wynn に帰されました。無事にね。
Queen's Recruit#526.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#527.src: ...if you don't mind me asking, Your Majesty, I thought we had an agreement? We would all remain here until the tournament concluded with the finals.
Queen's Recruit#527.dst: …お尋ねしてよろしければ、陛下、約束があったのでは？決勝でトーナメントが終わるまで、全員ここに残れるはずでした。
Queen's Recruit#527.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#528.src: Oh? And would you like to join the rest of them? That could certainly be arranged we could simply select a victor here and now, and be done with this whole
Queen's Recruit#528.dst: おや？では君も彼らに加わりたいのかね？手配はたやすいとも… 今ここで優勝者を選んで、この件をすべて終わらせても
Queen's Recruit#528.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#529.src: What is your problem, Thalas?! They're guests of Her Majesty! How irrational are you, trying to subtract them without her appr
Queen's Recruit#529.dst: 何が問題なんだ、Thalas？！陛下の客人だぞ！承認なしに彼らを引き算しようなど、どこまで不合理なんだ、陛下の承
Queen's Recruit#529.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#530.dst: おやめなさい。二人とも。
Queen's Recruit#530.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#531.src: To answer your question, the circumstances have changed. There is no need for the rest of your group to remain here.
Queen's Recruit#531.dst: 質問に答えましょう、状況が変わったのです。あなたの仲間がここに残る必要はもうありません。
Queen's Recruit#531.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#532.src: The remainder of the tournament will proceed as expected.
Queen's Recruit#532.dst: トーナメントの残りは予定通り進めます。
Queen's Recruit#532.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#534.src: Good. Now, let us enjoy the meal!
Queen's Recruit#534.dst: よろしい。では、食事を楽しみましょう！
Queen's Recruit#534.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#535.src: Another taste of Fruman cuisine... the meat was imported the {p}, and the vegetables came from the royal garden.
Queen's Recruit#535.dst: 再び Fruma の料理を… 肉は {p} から取り寄せ、野菜は王家の庭で採れたものです。
Queen's Recruit#535.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#536.src: Now, to business. The final will take place tomorrow morning. But first, I would like to speak to each of you individually.
Queen's Recruit#536.dst: では、本題に。決勝は明朝行います。ですがその前に、一人ずつお話がしたいのです。
Queen's Recruit#536.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#537.src: Let us begin with... {u}. Please come to the north-eastern wing when you are ready.
Queen's Recruit#537.dst: まずは… {u} から。準備ができたら北東の棟へいらっしゃい。
Queen's Recruit#537.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#539.src: Talk to Her Majesty in the north-eastern wing of the palace at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#539.dst: 宮殿北東の棟 [-{~}, {~}, {~}] で女王陛下と話す。

Queen's Recruit#542.src: Well. I suppose congratulations are in order, finalist.
Queen's Recruit#542.dst: さて。おめでとうと言うべきでしょうね、決勝進出者。
Queen's Recruit#542.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#543.src: You're curious, surely? For what purpose would I call you soldiers back to our province?
Queen's Recruit#543.dst: 気になっているのでしょう？わたくしが何のために兵士たちをこの地方へ呼び戻したのか。
Queen's Recruit#543.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#544.src: Certainly not for a vanity tournament. A meaningless celebration.
Queen's Recruit#544.dst: もちろん見栄のためのトーナメントではありません。無意味な祝典でも。
Queen's Recruit#544.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#545.src: Oh, let us drop the facade. I know what you have been doing in secret. I am not blind.
Queen's Recruit#545.dst: ああ、取り繕うのはやめましょう。あなたたちが陰で何をしていたか知っています。わたくしの目は節穴ではありません。
Queen's Recruit#545.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#546.src: You chose this opportunity to seek out information on our province. What little you have learned, we have deemed an acceptable cost.
Queen's Recruit#546.dst: あなたたちはこの機会に我が地方の情報を探ることを選んだ。わずかに知られたことは、許容できる代償と判断しました。
Queen's Recruit#546.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#547.src: Given the circumstances, I would have sacrificed much, much more if necessary.
Queen's Recruit#547.dst: この状況なら、必要とあらばもっと、ずっと多くを犠牲にしたでしょう。
Queen's Recruit#547.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#548.src: The greatest that Wynn has... a broad category. We had to thin the numbers a contest of strength did the job nicely.
Queen's Recruit#548.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#549.src: And now... two candidates remain. You have done well to make it this far. I have been watching the duels intently, and you are certainly not unimpressive.
Queen's Recruit#549.dst: そして今… 残る候補は二人。ここまでよく勝ち残りました。決闘は注意深く見ていましたが、あなたは確かに見劣りしません。
Queen's Recruit#549.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#550.src: Yet of the two of you... you certainly leave a lesser impression than him. You are one amongst hundreds, thousands... indistinguishable.
Queen's Recruit#550.dst: けれど二人のうち… あなたの印象は彼より明らかに薄い。あなたは何百、何千のうちの一人… 他と見分けがつかない。
Queen's Recruit#550.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#551.src: And still, here you stand. It intrigues me. What is so special about you? What strength has led you here?
Queen's Recruit#551.dst: それでも、あなたはここに立っている。興味をそそられます。あなたの何が特別なのでしょう？どんな力がここへ導いたのか？
Queen's Recruit#551.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#552.src: But no matter. Answers will come with time... should you be selected. I can tell you have a question. Speak it.
Queen's Recruit#552.dst: ですが構いません。答えはいずれ出ます… 選ばれればの話ですが。何か聞きたそうですね。言いなさい。
Queen's Recruit#552.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#553.src: Hm. A blank slate... to be able to see the outside world, for all its splendor and all its faults, to witness firsthand the deep rooted seeds of its inevitable destruction... there is value to that.
Queen's Recruit#553.dst: ふむ。白紙… 外の世界を、その輝きも欠点もすべて見ることができ、避けられぬ破滅の深く根ざした種を直に目撃できる… それには価値があるのです。
Queen's Recruit#553.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#554.src: You have seen it, haven't you? Forces beyond any of us vie for control of our world, caring not for what destruction they instill.
Queen's Recruit#554.dst: あなたも見たでしょう？我々の誰をも超える力が世界の支配を争い、自らもたらす破壊など気にも留めない。
Queen's Recruit#554.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#555.src: And it truly is a beautiful world, isn't it? To think, it could be destroyed, taken for their ceaseless war which holds no meaning, no purpose...
Queen's Recruit#555.dst: そして、本当に美しい世界でしょう？それが意味も目的もない果てしない戦争のために壊され、奪われるかもしれないなんて…
Queen's Recruit#555.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#556.src: Then you have seen firsthand the benefits. The province is unburdened by those who may cause problems, and Wynn's front in its war is bolstered.
Queen's Recruit#556.dst: ならば利点も直に見たはずです。地方は問題を起こしかねない者から解放され、Wynn の戦線は強化される。
Queen's Recruit#556.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#557.src: Of course, many will refuse the call. Many more will grow stagnant in their newfound roles. Yet, in a select few... there is potential for much, much more.
Queen's Recruit#557.dst: もちろん、多くは呼びかけを拒むでしょう。さらに多くは新たな役目で停滞する。けれど、ほんの一握りには… はるかに大きな可能性があるのです。
Queen's Recruit#557.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#558.dst: さて… あなたはどちらかしら？
Queen's Recruit#558.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#559.src: That will be all. Return to your chambers for the night. I will be sending for the other finalist shortly.
Queen's Recruit#559.dst: 以上です。今夜は部屋に戻りなさい。もう一人の決勝進出者もまもなく呼びにやります。
Queen's Recruit#559.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#560.src: Return to room W-{~} and talk to Tasim at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#560.dst: W-{~} 号室に戻り、[-{~}, {~}, {~}] で Tasim と話す。

Queen's Recruit#561.dst: どうぞ、お下がりなさい。
Queen's Recruit#561.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#562.src: You're back! Still in one piece?
Queen's Recruit#562.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#563.src: ...I was getting a little worried. You were up there a while.
Queen's Recruit#563.dst: …ちょっと心配してたんだ。ずいぶん長くいたから。
Queen's Recruit#563.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#564.dst: 彼女は何の用だったの？
Queen's Recruit#564.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#565.dst: …そうか。変な会話だったんだね？
Queen's Recruit#565.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#566.src: Ha. Well, now I'm a little nervous.
Queen's Recruit#566.dst: はは。今度は僕が緊張してきた。
Queen's Recruit#566.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#568.src: I'll... need to ask some follow-up questions.
Queen's Recruit#568.dst: 僕も… いくつか聞いてみないと。
Queen's Recruit#568.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#570.src: Oh, this is a disaster. We've been separated, and now we're stuck in here.
Queen's Recruit#570.dst: ああ、最悪だ。みんなと引き離されて、ここに閉じ込められた。
Queen's Recruit#570.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#571.src: We need to come up with a plan... is there a way we could
Queen's Recruit#571.dst: 計画を立てないと… 何か方法は
Queen's Recruit#571.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#572.src: Tasim! Her Majesty will speak with you now.
Queen's Recruit#572.dst: Tasim！女王陛下がお呼びです。
Queen's Recruit#572.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#574.src: Okay, wish me luck. I'll be back.
Queen's Recruit#574.dst: よし、幸運を祈ってて。戻るよ。
Queen's Recruit#574.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#575.src: Don't... stay up waiting for me. You can go rest. I'll be... fine, probably.
Queen's Recruit#575.dst: 僕を… 待って起きてなくていいから。休んで。僕は… たぶん平気。
Queen's Recruit#575.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#580.src: It went... fine, I guess. She probably said... most of the same things to you.
Queen's Recruit#580.dst: まあ… 普通だったかな。君に言ったのと… ほとんど同じことを言われたと思う。
Queen's Recruit#580.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#583.src: Could I ask you a favor?
Queen's Recruit#583.dst: 頼みがあるんだけど、いい？
Queen's Recruit#583.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#584.src: Could we spar? A test match, before... before tomorrow. Just like old times.

Queen's Recruit#593.src: I was going to ask if I could ask you a favor.
